Effect_FuelRodActivation_Desc: You've gained access to <sprite name="[other] fuel rod"> Fuel Rods. Crafted at the Field Engineering Station, these volatile cells greatly amplify the power of Rain Engines.
Effect_FuelRodsNegative_Desc: Inserting a Fuel Rod will immediately spawn {0} Blightrot Cyst(s). Blightrot Cysts will also appear {1} faster while using this Rain Engine.
Effect_FuneralFeast_Hostility_Desc: The funeral guests are slowly departing, but their movement disturbs the forest. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_FuneralFeast_Resolve_Desc: An aura of sorrow has befallen the town, with somber chants echoing from the Feast Hall.
Effect_FuneralFeast_WorkingSpeed_Desc: Life in the settlement seems to have slowed down. Scouts work {0} slower on glade events.
Effect_Gambler_RandomRaceFavoring_Desc: The Gambler seems to have a cruel sense of humor... Each season, a randomly selected species is favored.
Effect_GargoleHolstility_Desc: Villagers united in faith can lull the possessed demon back to sleep. Hostility is increased by {0}, but each villager with their Religion need fulfilled reduces it by {1}.
Effect_GargoleKillVillager_Desc: The vile spirit trapped within this statue must be purged, but it will require a sacrifice. Kills {0} random villager(s).
Effect_GargoyleDecoration_Desc: Rainwater production is increased by +1, and installing Rain Engines requires {0} fewer <sprite name="[mat processed] pipe"> Pipes.

Effect_Generic_GoodsRawProductionPenalty: All {0} production is reduced by {1} (whether from gathering, farming, or production).

Effect_Generic_ImpatienceFromEvent_Many_: Somehow, word of your decision has spread and reached the Queen. Viceroy executions are quite rare, but not as rare as you might hope. Gain {0} Impatience Points.
Effect_GhostGoodsRemoval_Desc: Pain and suffering speak through the phantoms of the past. Destroys all stored {0}.
Effect_GhostHostility_Desc: The offended ghost has brought misfortune upon you. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_GhostKill_Generic_Desc: The Restless Spirits want revenge, or they will never find peace. Kills {0} villagers ({1}).

Effect_GiftOfTheWoodlands_Desc: The Royal Woodlands are very lush and rich in timber. Trees give more <sprite name="[mat raw] wood"> wood.
Effect_GladeInfo_Airship_Desc: You can see the content of undiscovered glades.
Effect_GlobalReputationTresholdIncrease_: You took a very peculiar group of settlers with you. They seem perpetually dissatisfied. The Resolve threshold at which each species starts producing Reputation increases by {0} more point for every Reputation Point they generate.
More Resolve needed to gain Reputation.
Effect_GuildsDisfavor_Desc: The growing power of the Guild hasn't gone unnoticed. The Queen's Impatience grows by {0} every time goods worth {1} Amber are sold.
Effect_HardOrdersOnly_Desc: The Queen has decided to entrust you with the most difficult orders, as you are one of her most experienced viceroys.
Effect_HearthBonusHP_Desc: The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {0}.
Effect_HearthCorruptionRate_Desc: Allows firekeepers to combat corruption more efficiently. Every burned cyst removes an additional {0} corruption.
Effect_HearthHP500_Child_Desc: Blightrot Cysts will take {0} more seconds to burn until you destroy at least {1} of them (source: {2}).
Effect_HearthHP500_Desc: A complicated runic structure, designed to shield the hearth from corruption. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {0}.
Effect_HearthRelicWorkingSpeed_Desc: Glade event work speed increased by {0}.
Effect_HigherBlueprintsRerollCost_Desc: The Archivist assigned to your settlement is fiercely loyal to the Royal Court, so bribing him will be more expensive. Blueprint rerolls cost {0} Amber more.
Effect_HigherNeedsConsumptionRate_Desc: Villagers have forgotten what a modest life looks like. They want to enjoy life to the fullest. Villagers have a {0} chance of consuming double the amount of service goods.
Effect_HigherTradersPrices_Desc: Traders gossip about you doing pretty well lately. All your goods are worth {0} less to traders.
Effect_HigherTradersPrices_ShortDesc: Goods are worth less to traders.
Effect_Hostility_Generic_Desc: The forest’s Hostility is temporarily increased by {0} points.
Effect_HostilityForCysts_Desc: Every {0} burnt Blightrot Cysts lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityforDangerousRelics_Desc: One who lives in harmony with himself lives in harmony with all. Every Glade Event solved by making a decision marked as Empathy lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityforDeath_Desc: The forest requires sacrifices. Hostility is reduced by {0} every time {1} villagers die.
Effect_HostilityForGladeTrader_Desc: The forest saw what you did, and it remembers. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_Hostilityforrelics_Desc: Every Glade Event solved by making a decision marked as Loyalty lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityForTablets_Description: Archaeologists have learned how to decipher ancient tablets, and can now use that knowledge to appease the angry forest. You get {0} Hostility for every {1} in your settlement's Warehouse.

Effect_HostilityLower_Desc: A book by the renowned Stormwalker, Pervun Runebeak. Lowers Hostility by {0} points.

Effect_HubsForHostility_Desc: Hostility is reduced by {0} for every Hearth upgraded to: {1} (or higher).

Effect_HubTier_1_Desc: Some viceroys say aesthetics don't matter out in the wilds, but you know better than that. Global production speed is increased by {0} and global Resolve is increased by {1}. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {2}.

Effect_InstitutionGlobalExtraProduction_: Whether it's theater or martial arts, there's an inspiring show for everyone. The chance of producing double yields is increased by {0}.
Effect_InstitutionGlobalProductionRate_D: Regular baths improve everyone's well-being. Global production rate is {0} faster.
Effect_InstitutionMoreResolveFromMeat_De: Lizard tribes have a long tradition of both animal husbandry and meat preparation. All meat-based complex foods (jerky, skewers, pies, paste) give {0} more Resolve.
Effect_InstitutionResolveForComplexFood_: A rich diet is beneficial for your villagers' health. Gain +{0} to Global Resolve for every {1} times any complex food need is fulfilled (the bonus is added retroactively).
Effect_InstitutionSlowerLeaving_Descript: Every evening, villagers gather to talk, bathe, and strengthen their bonds with one another. Villagers with low resolve will leave the town {0} slower.
Effect_InstitutionSlowerSacrafice_Descri: There can be nothing more sacred than a flame in a world soaked with rain. Effect_KelpiesCharm_Desc: Villagers are under the spell of the Kelpie, controlled like marionettes. Every {1} seconds, {0} random villagers stop working and blindly walk toward the Kelpie where they hallucinate until the effect is gone.
Effect_LessFoodConsumption_Generic_Desc: Villagers have a {0} chance of not consuming food during a break.
Effect_LessNewcommers_Desc: The creatures of the forest are not enough for the warbeast, so it must find other, more easily accessible food sources. Every newcomer caravan arrives with {0} fewer villagers on board.
Effect_LightningCatcher_Desc: Some scholars are trying to capture and harness the power of lightning... but their experiments usually bring destruction instead. Lightning will turn {0} buildings into ruins.
Effect_LightningPayment_Penalty_Desc: If you don't deliver the required goods, 3 buildings will turn into ruins.
Effect_LocateGrass_Description: Reveals the location of {0} of the nearest patches of fertile soil
Effect_LocateSprings_Description: Reveals the location of {0} of the nearest geysers
Effect_LongerRelicsWorkingTime_Desc: Villagers are reluctant to venture into Dangerous Glades. Scouts work {0} slower on Glade Events.

Effect_LowerImpatienceReduction_Desc: The Queen expects a lot from a viceroy of your rank. Impatience falls by {0} points less for every Reputation Point you gain.
Effect_LowerImpatienceReduction_ShortDes: Impatience falls less on gaining Reputation.
Effect_MarshlandsGathererSpeed_Desc: The Marshlands are a gatherer's paradise. Gathering speed is increased by {0} for every {1} workers assigned to gathering camps.

Effect_MemoryoftheForest_Desc: Other viceroys tried to settle here before, and the forest still remembers their presence. Start with {0} Hostility points.
Effect_MesmerizingLight_Desc: A strange and evil light is coming from the top of the lighthouse. It mesmerizes the settlement's scouts, causing them to work {0} slower on Glade Events.

Effect_MineCarts_Desc: An automated minecart will help miners transport resources from the Mine to the Warehouse.
Effect_MissingCrudeWorkstation_Desc: Some half-witted fool lost the blueprint for the Crude Workstation. Start without the Crude Workstation, but with {0} of each building material.
Effect_MistwormFood_Desc: Where there is one mistworm, soon many more will follow. Destroys all stored food (both raw and cooked).
Effect_ModTreeEater_Desc: A pack of hungry Tree Grazers has been spotted nearby. One tree is eaten every {0} seconds, opening a maximum of {1} glades.
Effect_MoleEarthquake_Desc: Drainage moles are intelligent beings, but they can be very bad-tempered when hungry. Kills villagers and destroys all gathering nodes, buildings, and events within a {0} field radius.
Effect_MoleResolvePenalty_Composite_Desc: Villagers are afraid of going into the woods. All woodcutters, fishermen, and gatherers get a {0} penalty to Resolve.
Effect_Monolith_Desc: Making the right offering at the Obelisk reduces Hostility by {0} and increases the Ancient Hearth's resistance by {1}.
Effect_MoreAmberFromRoutes_Desc: Trade routes are worth {0} more <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber. Doesn't apply to routes already in progress. This effect scales along with the quantity of goods exported.
Effect_MoreCharges_Desc: A deeper mine level has revealed new mining veins: {0}.

Effect_MushroomInFarms_Desc: All farms can plant <sprite name="[food raw] mushrooms"> mushrooms ({0}) on farm fields during drizzle season.
Effect_Nocookingutensils_Desc: The caravan lost someone on the way, who unfortunately was carrying all the cooking equipment. All food recipes are {0} slower.

Factions_Blue_Goals: Find what is lost, understand what is unexplained, and remember what is forgotten. The mystery is what motivates the Vanguard to search deeper and deeper. There is no greater priority for them. Until we find the truth and discover what has been forgotten, we will never find our true selves. And without that, we are nobody. Why do we need riches, or a long prosperous life, if we don't understand anything? History is the key to our future.
Factions_Blue_Methods: Immersed in old libraries and archives, filled with the desire to find all the remnants of the Old World. They bravely venture into even the most dangerous regions, as they feel it's their destiny to explore. They are not afraid, and they do not withdraw. She guides them. They trust her. They pray, and go on another difficult expedition. How many will come back this time? It does not matter. This is the price of discovery.
Factions_Blue_PublicOpinion: There are various rumors about the Vanguard. Whoever joins them changes forever. Some are afraid of them, or consider them fanatics who commit terrible acts in the name of knowledge. But there are two sides to every coin. Thanks to their research, we have a chance to learn more about the terrifying world around us. Maybe one day, we’ll even understand it, and learn to live in harmony with it. Or perhaps, we may even find a way to stop the Blightstorm?
Factions_Blue_Relationships: They venture into any ruins they can find, looking for ancient artifacts and relics. They’ll refuse to share their knowledge, unless you can offer them something in return. This attitude creates a strenuous relationship between the factions. Most of the time, however, the Vanguard pretends to be neutral... Until something angers them.
Factions_Green_Goals: For the First Dawn Company, the two most important things in life are social standing and wealth. They like to establish settlements close to fertile lands, where they can quickly produce food in enormous quantities. Thanks to this tactic, they control the production and distribution of food throughout the realm. If you don’t take care of your supply chains quickly, you’ll soon be completely dependent on them.
Factions_Green_Methods: It's all about the money. The First Dawn Company are ruthless materialists, who trade not only in resources or food, but sometimes even in people too. Nothing will stop them if there's profit to be made.
Factions_Green_Motto: “No bees, no honey; no work, no money”
Factions_Green_PublicOpionion: On one hand, it might seem that the First Dawn Company only thinks about profit - but on the other, without them, we would face an economic crisis. It's not easy to travel in a merchant's cart down dangerous valleys, so people are grateful for the First Dawn's logistical prowess.
Factions_Green_Relationships: It does not go unnoticed by the other factions that the First Dawn Company gladly endows the Queen with riches to win her favor. However, it's unknown if this tactic will win them her trust in the long run.
Factions_Orange_Goals: Innovators, pioneers, people of progress. They have only one goal: to tame the storm. Tame it, and use its potential for the benefit of all people. That's why their specialization lies in creating Rainpunk technology. Advanced machines, durable tools, workshops and shelters, even eternal bonfires - all are their creations. Whatever will they surprise us with next?
Factions_Orange_Methods: People of ambition and diligence. They will not rest until they prove to everyone (and above all, to the Queen) that they are the best engineers in the realm. They’re not looking for fame or riches. Their reward is simply in their sense of security, and the gratitude of all species.
Factions_Orange_PublicOpinion: Adored by many, but hated by some. Most people are eternally grateful for their toil and hard work, but some despise their creations. Most religious groups fear that the Brass Order will bring doom upon the kingdom by mindlessly exploiting the natural environment. It's said that some settlements have already fallen due to the Curse of the Forest, brought about by the Brass Order's machines. Survivors warn, and remember...
Factions_Orange_Relationships: The Brass Order works well with the First Dawn Company, but they are in eternal conflict with the Vanguard of the Stolen Keys. Their visions and mindsets are complete polar opposites. The question is not "if" this conflict will escalate, but rather "when".
GameAlerts_Blight_Description: There are enough Blightrot Cysts ({0}) to overwhelm the firekeeper and corrupt the Ancient Hearth. With your current corruption rate (+{1} corruption / min.), the Hearth's resistance will drop to 0 at least once during this storm. Prepare to fight!
GameAlerts_CompletedOrders_Description: Complete orders to unlock unique rewards, and unlock new blueprints with Reputation Points.
GameAlerts_CompletedTimedOrders_Descript: Timed orders have to be delivered before the time runs out!
GameAlerts_DangerousGladeTooSoon_Descrip: Your settlement is not yet prepared for the threats that can be found in Dangerous Glades! Unmark the trees leading to the Dangerous Glade, and follow your orders for now.
GameAlerts_DeadlyHostility_Description: High Hostility of the Forest during the storm will crush your people's Resolve. To lower Hostility, unassign woodcutters, sacrifice fuel in the Ancient Hearth, or build additional hearths. Check the hostility icon on the upper HUD to read more about Hostility sources.
GameAlerts_LowFire_Description: The fire in your main Hearth is going out! Without it, your villagers' Resolve will fall drastically!
GameAlerts_LowFood_Description: Your villagers will eat anything, if necessary, but with no food at all they will starve. Build new food production buildings, or assign workers to existing ones.
GameAlerts_LowFuel_Description: The village needs fuel (wood, coal, oil) for the Hearth. Build more Woodcutters' Camps and assign more woodcutters.
GameAlerts_LowResolve_Description: To increase the Resolve of a given species, provide food they like, meet their needs, and build houses. You can also invest in perks and effects that will boost their Resolve.
GameAlerts_Newcomers_Description: Once in a while, you can welcome a new group of villagers. Don't let them wait too long!
GameAlerts_NewOrders_Description: Periodically, you’ll be assigned new orders from the Citadel. Select the envelope icon in the upper right corner to check the new objectives.
GameAlerts_NoBlackMarket_Desc: You won't last long in these harsh lands without a Black Market. Build one to gain access to resource deals.
GameAlerts_NoBuilders_Description: Only villagers who aren't assigned to a building can build structures. Press {0} on a worker's portrait in the building panel to make them a builder.
GameAlerts_NoCompletedOrders_Description: The Queen gave you orders - keep track of them and try to complete them to advance your settlement.
GameAlerts_NoDeposits_Description: This building needs a gathering node to continue working. It either doesn't have access to one or is located too far from one to be efficient.
GameAlerts_NoFarmfields_Description: Farmers can only plant crops on farm fields that have been built on fertile soil.
GameAlerts_NoFirekeeper_Description: Without a firekeeper assigned to the Main Hearth, the fire will die out, and your villagers will perish.
GameAlerts_NoLakes_Description: This building needs a fishing pond to continue working. It either doesn't have access to one, or has insufficient bait to continue.
GameAlerts_NoLumberCamp_Description: To survive, the village needs a constant supply of wood. Build a Woodcutters' Camp.
GameAlerts_NoNaturalResources_Descriptio: There are no trees suitable for felling within the building's area. Move the Woodcutters' Camp closer to the forest, or change the camp's settings.
GameAlerts_NoOre_Description: A mine has depleted all of its available veins. Demolish it and look for new mining veins in nearby glades.
GameAlerts_NoOre_UpgradeAvailableDescrip: A mine has depleted all of its available veins. You can upgrade it to reach lower levels and gain access to more mining veins.
GameAlerts_NoParts_Description: Parts are required to build camps and expand the village. Salvage unused camps, or venture into the wilds to acquire this rare resource.
GameAlerts_NoTreesMarked_Description: To cut through the forest and reach glades faster, you can mark certain trees for felling. Select the axe icon on the right-hand side of the lower HUD, and drag the pointer over the trees.
GameAlerts_NoWoodcutters_Description: To survive, the village needs a constant supply of wood. Assign at least 4 workers to your Woodcutters' Camps.
GameAlerts_PoroFull_Desc: The Fluffbeak's pasture is full of manure.
GameAlerts_ReputationRewards_Description: You can choose a new blueprint as a reward for earning Reputation Points. Press the pulsing number on the reputation bar at the bottom of the screen.
GameAlerts_RoadsDestroyed_Alert_Descript: All your roads have been destroyed due to flooding caused by: Rain Spirit Totem
GameAlerts_SealPlague_Desc: The Ancient Seal is crumbling, releasing a new plague every storm. {0}: {1}
GameAlerts_SeasonRewards_Description: From time to time, the Queen will offer you powerful cornerstones. Select the Queen's Mask icon in the top right corner of the screen.
GameAlerts_Starvation_Description: {1} ({0}) are so starved, they will die if they don't eat during their next break.
GameAlerts_TooManyTreesMarked_Descriptio: Forest exploration is essential, and marking too many trees can slow you down. Use the axe icon with the minus sign on the right hand side of the lower HUD to unselect marked trees.
GameAlerts_UnresolvedRelics_Description: You can interact with objects found in the forest. Allocate resources, assign workers, choose rewards, and give orders to investigate.
GameAlerts_UnseenRelics_Description: Woodcutters have discovered a new dangerous event in the forest!
GameAlerts_UnstartedRelics_Description: An event found in the forest has workers assigned, but no orders to investigate were given.
GameAlerts_UpcomingPayment_Description: One or more of your payments is due next season.
GameUI_AchievementTooltip_Desc: Completing this deed will also reward you with an achievement.
GameUI_AltarPanel_Inactive_Description: The priestess will only arrive during the storm, and only after you acquire an Altar Activation charge from earning <color=#e0e09f>Reputation</color>.
GameUI_AltarPanel_NPC_Description: "Gythe'th bless you, outsider. For a small fee, I can grant you unimaginable power... far greater than any boon the false queen can offer you."
GameUI_Archaeologist_NextLevel_Tooltip_D: To buy an upgrade, you need to meet the requirements. The necessary resources can be changed to other resources by selecting the resource icon. Once an upgrade has been purchased, it cannot be refunded or exchanged for another.
GameUI_Archaeologist_Upgrades_Tooltip_De: In the Archaeologist's Office, you can buy upgrades that reveal the location of an excavation site or aid exploration. The first upgrade is available for free. Only one upgrade can be purchased per row.
GameUI_BatsShrine_Abilities_Tooltip_Desc: Choose a species to punish. One of its members will leave the settlement, permanently increasing the productivity of all workers.
GameUI_BlackMarketOffersTooltip_Desc: The Syndicate has updated its offers since you last checked.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_CreditButton_Des: The loan must be repaid within 3 seasons (by the start of {0} in year {1}), or the Syndicate will kidnap {2} villagers.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_CreditRating_Bad: According to Zhera's calculations, the interest rate on this offer is a ripoff.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_CreditRating_Goo: According to Zhera's calculations, the interest rate on this offer is favorable.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_CreditRating_Med: According to Zhera's calculations, the interest rate on this offer is fair.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Npc_Dialogue: "Many greetings, Viceroy. Running low on wood again, are we? I'm sure we can arrange something..."
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Bad: According to Zhera's calculations, the Syndicate is attempting to exploit your situation with this offer.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Good: According to Zhera's calculations, the margin on this transaction is unusually low.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Medium: According to Zhera's calculations, this offer strikes a fair bargain with a reasonable margin.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_RerollButtonTool: You can pay the Black Amber Syndicate to refresh their offers. This action has a cooldown.
GameUI_BlightOverlay_ToggleTooltip_Desc: You can use this button to prevent Blight Fighters from burning Cysts on this building. An open padlock indicates that Cysts will be burned. A closed padlock means that Blight Fighters will ignore this building.
GameUI_BlightPanel_Ignored_Tooltip_Desc: You can prevent Blight Fighters from burning Cysts on certain buildings by using the toggle in the Blightrot Overlay ({0}).
GameUI_BlightPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Industrial production affects Blightrot levels. The higher the recipe's Blightrot footprint, the faster Blightrot Cysts will grow. Once the storm starts, the cysts will try to corrupt the Ancient Hearth. To prevent that, build Blight Posts and assign Blight Fighters.
GameUI_BlightPost_LimitLocked: All Blight Posts will have the same limits.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Priority_GlobalTool: Hold {0} to set a priority for all buildings of this type.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_PriorityPanel_Toolt: Lower priority goods will be produced only after higher priority recipes reach their limits or run out of ingredients. Goods with equal priority will be produced on an alternating basis.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_RecipesPanel_Limit_: Workers will produce goods until the limit has been reached. After that, they will try to continuously keep it at that level.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_SleepButton_Tooltip: Inactive construction sites will be ignored by builders.
An inactive production building will be ignored by haulers, and all workers will immediately leave it. Assigning new workers will automatically activate the building again.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_SpecializationToolt:
Cooperation (Comfortable)
(applies when 3 or more Foxes work in the same building)
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Storage_Good_Toolti: {0} to force delivery {0} + {1} for constant delivery
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Tabs_StorageEffects: This list shows global values. Bonuses or effects that only apply to a particular villager or building are not included.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_CystsSufix: Cysts on this building ({0}) will move to another structure.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_Description: You are trying to remove: {0}. This action will refund: {1}.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_KeySufix: (Hold {0} when removing buildings to skip this popup)
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_None_Descrip: You are trying to remove: {0}. No goods will be refunded, as none were spent.
GameUI_BuildingSlot_OrdersTooltipAlert: This blueprint is a reward in one of your orders.
GameUI_BuildingsPickScreen_BonusPoints_T: Reserve Embarkation Points are earned by completing activities on the World Map. They are a separate pool of non-rechargeable points that can only be used during this cycle.
GameUI_BuildingsPickScreen_Tooltip_Desc: Before each game, you can use your Embarkation Points to bring extra goods, blueprints, or perks with your caravan.
GameUI_BuildingStatsPanel_Tooltip_Desc: These stats can change depending on the recipe the worker is using, or the effects that apply to a particular villager.
GameUI_BuildingStoragePanel_Tooltip_Desc: Each resource in a building has its own storage limit. When a resource reaches its limit, it will be moved to a warehouse. You can also select a resource and force it to be delivered immediately, or enable automatic delivery after each unit is produced.
GameUI_CampPanel_DontOpenGladesToggle_To: Hold {0} to change this setting in all Woodcutters' Camps.
GameUI_CampPanel_ShareButton_TooltipDesc: Propagate this mode across all Woodcutters' Camps.
GameUI_CapitalSupportPopup_Game_Descript: Some of your previously bought Citadel upgrades are no longer supported. Here are the resources you spent on them:
GameUI_CapitalSupportPopup_Game_Header: Your Citadel save is no longer supported
GameUI_ConstructionPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Construction priority can range from -5 to +5. Buildings with a higher priority value will be built first.
GameUI_ConsumptionPopup_SecondaryToggleT: This species will eat this type of food only as a last resort. You can forbid it, but this will starve them.
GameUI_ConsumptionPopupButton_LockedInMe: Unlock consumption control by buying the Obsidian Archive Level 2 upgrade in the Smoldering City.
GameUI_CornerstonesPopup_EtherealTooltip: This cornerstone option will disappear if you decide to unpause the game before choosing it.
GameUI_CursedTreasure_Desc: The Treasure Stag has been captured, and you claim its treasure - but the mythical forest spirit curses your greedy soul.
GameUI_CystSlotTooltip_Descc: Each cyst will increase the Ancient Hearth's corruption during the storm.
GameUI_DangerIcon_Tooltip_Desc: This glade contains a threat, but it also gives plenty of rewards in return.
GameUI_DemoLanding_Desc:
Your progress from the demo was successfully loaded! You can now continue playing with the new content or replay the tutorial (you won't lose your progress).

You can also reset or create a new profile in the upper right corner of the main menu.
GameUI_DemoLanding_Header: Thank you for playing the demo!
GameUI_DemoReturnPopup_Description: You launched the demo after playing the full version of Against the Storm. Returning to the demo version is not supported and could corrupt your saves. Use the quit button if you started it by mistake.
GameUI_DemoThankYou_Desc: Discover all the new features available in the full version of Against the Storm.
GameUI_DepositPanel_Priority_GlobalToolt: Hold {0} to set a priority for all gathering nodes of this type. The priority set in camps takes precedence over the priority set for gathering nodes.
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Bats_Decs: You have gained a new ally - the Bats - a stern and fiercely devoted people, renowned for their exceptional metallurgical skills and indomitable resilience. You’ve also discovered strange new lands - the Rocky Ravine and the Bamboo Flats. (The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Bats as a playable species, you must reach level 11)
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Frogs_Decs: You have gained a new ally - the Frogs - a dignified and proud people known for their exceptional architectural skills and their love of water. You’ve also discovered strange new lands - the Coastal Grove and the Ashen Thicket. (The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Frogs as a playable species, you must reach level 9)
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Frogs_Header: Keepers of the Stone DLC is now active!
GameUI_ErrorPopup_Description: We were unable to load your settlement. An automatic report has been sent. Press the New Settlement button to resume playing where you left off before the error occurred, or return to the Main Menu. If the problem persists, please verify the integrity of your local files or contact us on <style="link"><link="discord">Discord</link></style> or via <style="link"><link="helpdesk">our helpdesk</link></style>.
GameUI_ErrorPopup_ValidationRequired_Des: Some game files have become corrupted during installation, or due to a recent update. Please follow <style="link"><link="validation">these instructions</link></style> and verify the integrity of your game files. If this problem persists, please contact us through <style="link"><link="discord">Discord</link></style> or <style="link"><link="helpdesk">our helpdesk</link></style>.
GameUI_EtherealDecisionPopup_Desc: One of your cornerstone picks is ephemeral, and will disappear if you unpause the game. Do you want to unpause anyway?
GameUI_EtherealDecisionPopup_Order_Desc: One of your order picks is ephemeral, and will disappear if you unpause the game. Do you want to unpause anyway?
GameUI_FarFromHearthIconTooltip_Desc: This building needs to be within the range of an active Hearth.
GameUI_FarmPanel_PlowedFieldsTooltip_Des: During the storm, the rainfall is so heavy that the soil absorbs some of its qualities. Farmers can plow farm fields to ensure a {0} chance of growing extra crops next year.
GameUI_FeedbackPopup_ContactInfo:
Please use this form to report specific bugs or leave feedback.

Reports are anonymous, so we won't be able to reply. To talk to us directly, please message us on Discord or via contact@eremitegames.com.
GameUI_FeedbackPopup_Error: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
GameUI_FieldTooltip_Header_Description: Farm fields can be built on this land. To grow crops, a Farm or Plantation is required nearby.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_BaitPanel_Dropdow: There are 3 options for bait fishing. "None" - fishermen will never use bait, "Optional" - fishermen will use bait when available, "Only With Bait" - fishermen will not fish when no bait is available.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_BaitPanel_Tooltip: You can use Packs of Crops as ground bait to double the yield from fishing. Fishermen take one piece of bait per production cycle.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_PriorityPanel_Too: Lower priority resources will not be collected until higher priority fishing ponds are depleted. Resources with the same priority will be collected alternately. This priority overrides the priority set at individual fishing ponds.
GameUI_ForbiddenIcon_Tooltip_Desc: The crown sends a warning about this glade! It's very dangerous, and requires a lot of resources to explore, but will contain great amounts of treasure.
GameUI_FuelPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Each cyst takes 1 <sprite name="blight fuel"> Purging Fire to be burned. This bar shows the amount of fuel you have, and compares it to the number of Blightrot Cysts in your settlement.
GameUI_FuelRodsPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Inserting a Fuel Rod into a Rain Engine doubles its effectiveness, but also increases the speed at which Blightrot Cysts appear. Fuel Rods have limited power, which is consumed during production. Once depleted, they must be replaced.
GameUI_GameMenu_Abandon_PopupDesc: This settlement won't survive, and all villagers will take refuge in the Citadel.
GameUI_GameMenu_Abandon_PopupHeader: Do you want to abandon this town?
GameUI_GameMenu_AbandonIronman_PopupDesc: If you abandon a settlement during the Queen's Hand Trial, you will condemn yourself to death. There is no turning back.
GameUI_GameMenu_MoveOn_PopupDesc: This settlement has already proven its resilience, and you are free to start a new expedition.
GameUI_GameMenu_MoveOn_PopupHeader: Do you want to leave this town?
GameUI_GameMenu_RemoveProfile_PopupHeade: Do you want to remove this profile: {0}?
GameUI_GameMenu_ReplayTutorial_PopupDesc: None of your progress will be lost, but you won't have access to some of your upgrades and buildings during the tutorial.
GameUI_GameMenu_ReplayTutorial_PopupHead: Do you want to replay the tutorial?
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupDesc: This can't be undone! ALL data from this profile ({0}) will be cleared and you will start afresh!
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupDesc_: This can't be undone! Your world will be generated with a new seed.
This can't be undone! Because you only won {0} runs, the world map will not be generated with a different seed.
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupHeade: Do you want to reset your progress?
GameUI_GameResult_Lost_Description: The Queen is not satisfied with your efforts here. You were summoned back to the court, and have lost the right to this land.
GameUI_GameResult_Lost_Seal_Description: It's too late... The Sealed Ones have taken control of this land once again, and the coming Blightstorm will only strengthen their influence.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_ContinuePopup_Desc: You won't be able to complete additional deeds, and you will not earn any more experience points or Citadel Resources.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Description: The village's position has been secured. You can now choose to leave, or continue to play on this map - but any additional deeds won't be completed, and you will not earn any more experience points or Citadel Resources.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Seal_Description: It's done... The Sealed Ones are imprisoned once again! Thank you, Viceroy. You not only saved our world, but also rekindled the flame of hope in our people - the faith in something that until now was only a legend of old.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Tutorial_Descripti: This village has been secured. But there is one more test of your skills.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Tutorial2_Descript: You proved your worth by securing this settlement! Your training is hereby complete.
GameUI_GathererHutPanel_PriorityPanel_To: Lower priority resources will not be collected until higher priority gathering nodes are depleted. Resources with the same priority will be collected alternately. This priority overrides the priority set at individual gathering nodes.
GameUI_GladeIcon_RewardChase_Tooltip_Des: The Treasure Stag is hiding in this glade. After the timer expires, the stag will run away, and the chance to receive its treasure will be gone.
GameUI_GoodsHUD_Sacrifice_TooltipDesc: You are sacrificing fuel in the Hearth.
GameUI_GoodsMenu_StorageLimitTooltip_Des: This resource has a minimum reserve set in the Main Warehouse. Workers will only use it if the amount exceeds the minimum reserve.
GameUI_GratitudeGift_Desc: The Treasure Stag vanishes into the mists, leaving you with a gift as gratitude for your empathy.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Blight_Tooltip_Desc: If there are Blightrot Cysts on buildings in the settlement, they will wake up during the storm and corrupt the Ancient Hearth. Upgrade your Hearths to reinforce the Main Hearth, and build Blight Posts to send Blight Fighters to burn cysts.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Fuel_Tooltip_Desc: There always has to be at least one Hearth burning. You can choose which goods the firekeeper will use to sustain the flame.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_DecorationsDesc: At least {1} {0} decorations have to be built within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_InstitutionDesc: At least {0} service building (like a Tavern or Temple) has to be built within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_Next_LastReachedU: (more can be unlocked in the Smoldering City)
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_PopulationDesc: At least {0} villagers have to be housed within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hubs_Tooltip_Desc: Hearths can be upgraded by building homes, decorations, and service buildings within their range. Each level will grant you bonuses to Resolve, production speed, and production output. These bonuses stack with each Hearth in your settlement.
GameUI_HearthPanel_NoEffectsHeader: Nothing can be sacrificed in this Hearth.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Sacrifice_Tooltip_Des: During especially hard times, you can sacrifice additional goods in the Hearth to temporarily gain positive effects. Each fuel type grants different boons, like increasing your production speed, decreasing Hostility, etc.
GameUI_HearthPanel_StopAfterStorm_Toolti: Mark this checkbox to automatically stop sacrificing as soon as the Storm ends. You can set a default value in the Options menu under the Gameplay tab.
GameUI_HearthServicesPanel_Desc: You can expand the Main Hearth with the Commons - a shared space where villagers can fulfill service needs like Leisure, Luxury, Religion, etc. Satisfying needs here grants a smaller Resolve bonus than in dedicated service buildings.
GameUI_HousePanel_ResidentTooltip_Defaul: Select a slot to lock it. It will prevent a villager from moving into this house.
GameUI_HousePanel_ResidentTooltip_Locked: Select a slot to unlock it. It will allow a villager to move into this house.
GameUI_Houses_Upgrades_Tooltip_Desc: Species-specific houses can be upgraded using packs of goods. Each house has four upgrades in total (two for each row), but you can only choose one upgrade per row.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_Cancel: Clear marked trees{2}. Hold {0} for a smaller marker. Hold {1} to mark trees instead.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_Default: Mark trees for harvesting{3}. Useful when trying to carve a path to nearby glades. Hold {0} for a smaller marker. Hold {1} to exclude trees on the edge of glades. Hold {2} to clear marked trees instead.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_NoCamps: Build a Woodcutters' Camp to cut down trees
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_NoForagers: Assign woodcutters in the Woodcutters' Camp to harvest trees
GameUI_IdleBuildingIconTooltip_Desc: No one in this building is working. Unassign idle workers or change recipes.
GameUI_IdleRelicIconTooltip_Desc: A newly discovered Glade Event is waiting for your action.
GameUI_IdleRuinIconTooltip_Desc: A building destroyed by the elements. Assign workers to rebuild it.
GameUI_LakePanel_Fishing_Tooltip_Desc: Fishermen are not gatherers, and collect resources differently. They first catch fish and algae in nets, and then transport them directly to a warehouse when the entire fishing pond is depleted. Resources held in nets are not available for use in production or consumption; they must first be transported to a warehouse.
GameUI_LakePanel_Nets_Tooltip_Desc: Resources from fishing ponds are first collected in a net and are only transported to a warehouse when the entire pond is depleted. You can choose to collect the nets earlier, but the fishing pond will automatically be depleted.
GameUI_LakePanel_Priority_GlobalTooltip: Hold {0} to set a priority for all fishing ponds of this type.
GameUI_LakePanel_RetriveButton_Confirmat: Are you sure you want to retrieve the net early? You will receive the resources it has collected, but the fishing pond will be depleted.

GameUI_LowerHUD_Texts_Harvesting: {0} and hold to mark trees for harvesting
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_Abilities_Toolti: Abilities are special effects that can be manually activated in the Main Warehouse and have a limited number of uses. You can acquire new abilities by solving world events on the world map.
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_LockTooltip_Desc: If you set a minimum reserve for a resource, production buildings will only use it if the amount exceeds the set limit. This only applies to recipe ingredients. A closed padlock indicates that the limit is active.
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_Tooltip_Desc: In this panel you can select goods you want to track in a special resource category on the HUD, and set a minimum reserve limit for resources kept in the warehouse. If an item has a minimum reserve limit, production buildings will only use it if its quantity exceeds the limit. Actions like villagers eating, scouts solving events, or you completing orders do not respect this limit.
GameUI_NewcomersPopup_Dialogue: "These people have been sent here by the Crown. Which group do you want to stay, Viceroy? The other will continue on to the next settlement."

GameUI_NoGoodsIconTooltip_Relic_Desc: Missing one or more materials required to complete the event.

GameUI_PaymentsPopup_AutoPayment_Tooltip: You can set your payment to be automatically paid by your Royal Treasurer. "Instant" means that payment will be made as soon as there are enough resources in the Main Warehouse. "Last minute" means that the payment will be made just before the deadline. GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_Button_Tooltip: Forging a cornerstone will consume one Thunderblight Shard. You can only forge 3 cornerstones in one settlement.

GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_NPC_ActiveDialog: Ah, just what this flame-forsaken wasteland needed - another Viceroy. If you want a cornerstone, bring me a Thunderblight Shard, and I'll make you one.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_NPC_UsedDialogue: Sorry, no can do - three Cornerstones is the limit. Royal decree, something about "protecting the land"... you know how it is.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_Tooltip_Desc: To create a cornerstone, you must choose a condition and a reward/effect. The effect stacks based on how many times the condition is triggered. Both conditions and effects have a random rating (stars). You can choose an optional penalty to increase the rating of either the condition or the effect (indicated by a line connecting the penalty to one of them). Finally, you need to choose an icon and name your new cornerstone.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_Desc: "No one can weather the storm alone. The Queen offers you a cornerstone that will lay the foundation for your town's prosperity. Choose wisely, as you won't be able to change it."
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_Reroll_Tooltip: Each settlement only has a limited number of cornerstone rerolls. More can be acquired by buying upgrades in the Smoldering City.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_SealedBiomeExtra_D: You are one step closer to reforging the seal. My gifts may not be as powerful as the Queen's, but nevertheless, I offer you a Cornerstone as a reward.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_SkipButton_Tooltip: You can decline a cornerstone to receive Amber instead. Each time you do, the reward decreases by 2 Amber, down to a minimum of 5.

GameUI_PoroPanel_Needs_Tooltip_Desc: A healthy, happy Fluffbeak is a symbol of prosperity, and a source of pride for your villagers. By providing the right goods to the Giant Fluffbeak, you'll meet its needs and boost its overall well-being.

GameUI_PortPanel_ExtraRewards_Tooltip_De: These waters hold many secrets. The more supplies you provide, the longer the Strider will search, and the better your chances of finding a higher rarity treasure chest.
GameUI_PortPanel_Requirements_Tooltip_De: Before sending out an expedition, you must supply both the Water Strider and its rider with food. You can also use more supplies to increase your chances of getting a higher rarity treasure chest.
GameUI_PortPanel_Rewards_Tooltip_Desc: Expeditions alternate between two types: blueprint expeditions and treasure expeditions. Blueprint expeditions give you a blueprint and a treasure chest, while treasure expeditions offer only a treasure chest, but with a higher chance of getting a higher rarity one. Investing more supplies increases the likelihood of finding higher-rarity chests.
GameUI_PortPanel_Time_Tooltip_Desc: Each expedition has a set duration, and you won't receive the rewards until it's completed. Investing more supplies for a higher chance of finding a rare reward will also increase the expedition's duration.

GameUI_SaveSupportPopup_Game_Description: Due to a recent update, your settlement data was reset. This happens because we're constantly improving Against the Storm, and in order to keep delivering big, meaningful updates on a regular basis, we sometimes need to invalidate your game save. Here are the rewards you would have got for finishing the run. The upgrades in your Citadel remain intact.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_1: The seal opens, unleashing the vengeful monstrosities trapped beneath. Hungry for revenge, they unleash plagues on the settlement with every storm. Your only chance of success is to collect four parts of the Ancient Guardian and close it. For each part, you must complete only one of the three objectives.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_2: You have the Guardian's Heart, but you still have a long way to go... Choose your next steps wisely. Time is ticking, and as the years go by, the Sealed Ones will unleash even more terrible plagues upon the settlement. May the Holy Flame protect you!
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_3: The Blood of the Guardian already flows in its heart. Now we need something that will help it rise high above this evil land. With its countenance, it will shield our world from the terrors of the depths. Maybe I'll finally get to see it... for the first time, with my own eyes.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_4: The Guardian begins to take shape. All that is left is to breathe a living, spiritual essence into it, so that it will finally rise and defeat our enemies with the power it has torn from them. People have regained hope, although they suffer more than ever. They still believe in you. Don't fail us now!
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_Final: Thank you, Viceroy. You not only saved our world, but also rekindled the flame of hope in our people - the faith in something that until now was only a legend of old. Now I can finally rest... Take care. We will meet again, I'm sure. Be always on your guard, for evil never rests.

Intro_1: The world is plagued by the Blightstorm - a vile cycle of destruction ravaging everything in its path. The only safe haven is the Smoldering City, where the mysterious Scorched Queen reigns.
Intro_2: You are one of her viceroys - a pioneer sent into the wilds, tasked with establishing new settlements and acquiring valuable resources for the crown.
Intro_3: Your goal is to help rebuild the Smoldering City, and secure the future of the Queen’s subjects.

Marketing_Bundle_dotAGE_Description: Celebrate the collaboration between two roguelite city builders! Encounter new events in dotAGE to find a Beaver VIP and help him get safe passage into your town. Start a new World Event in Against the Storm to convince the Elder the cataclysm isn't coming — and gain a purring ally.
Marketing_Description_Long_Villagers_Tex: Beavers, lizards, and foxes stand alongside humans and harpies in the struggle to survive. Utilize each group’s strengths as you balance their varying needs, from housing and culinary preferences to taste in luxuries and recreation. Manufacture raincoats, brew ale, and bake pies to boost morale in the face of the oppressive hostility of the forest.
Marketing_Description_Short: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, harpies, and foxes to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.

Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line01: Greetings, Viceroys, and welcome to the Ancient Seals Overview Briefing.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line02: Let us not waste time - the Blightstorm is almost upon us.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line03: It’s our last chance to close the Ancient Seal!
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line04: Ancient Seals are old, intricate structures built to hold a primeval, malevolent force at bay.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line05: As time passed, they became weaker, causing the mysterious Sealed Ones to slowly reclaim their dominion over our world.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line06: Your task as the Queen’s Viceroy is to settle the lands and journey into the heart of the Sealed Forest, where you must reforge the seal to imprison the evil gods.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line07: Our reports speak of 8 different seals.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line08: The farther away they are, the higher their difficulty,
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line09: and the more seal fragments will be required to repair the shattered seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line10: You can acquire seal fragments by establishing settlements,
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line12: and solving World Events encountered on your caravan's journey.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line13: At the start of every cycle, your caravan departs from the Smoldering City.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line14: You can upgrade your caravan permanently with Smoldering City upgrades that add new embarkation bonuses, increase its embarkation range, and much more.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line15: You can also modify the caravan temporarily with Royal Resupplies and World Events.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line16: Royal Resupplies are special rewards awarded for settling near negative modifiers.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line17: You can choose from three different one-time bonuses: increased vision and embarkation range, reserve embarkation points, or additional seal fragments. Choose your boon wisely.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line18: Reserve embarkation points are a separate pool of non-rechargeable embarkation points that can only be used during this cycle.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line19: You may want to save them for the most challenging endeavors.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line20: You can also improve your caravan by solving World Events.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line21: Yet, tread with caution. Your decisions often come with a trade-off, or present a unique challenge.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line22: Once you gather enough seal fragments, you can travel to the Sealed Forest - a grim, uninhabitable biome - where the Ancient Seals lie, and where your governing skills will be put to the test.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line23: This can only be attempted once per cycle.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line24: Ancient Seals spread corruption around them, making the Sealed Forest an extremely hostile environment.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line25: The flora in this region is bizarrely mutated.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line26: The overgrown trees contain extra resource charges.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line27: You will want your woodcutters to focus on them, for unlike anywhere else, the Hostility in the Sealed Forest grows with every felled tree.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line28: A broken Ancient Seal is concealed within the depths of the Sealed Forest. You must search for clues in the surrounding glades.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line29: Every glade contains a destroyed guidance stone that points to the location of the Ancient Seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line31: See, here’s the thing about the Sealed Forest. Viceroys don't embark there to establish settlements or gain Reputation. The Queen expects you to reforge the seal… Or die trying.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line32: To reforge the seal, you must construct the Ancient Guardian by obtaining its heart, blood, feathers, and life essence.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line33: There are three different variants of each part. Acquiring even one of them will require a display of remarkable finesse in a certain aspect of managing a settlement.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line34: Once you obtain the part, you will be rewarded with an Epic Cornerstone, and a new array of objectives will be revealed.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line35: After assembling all four parts, the Scorched Queen will breathe life into the Ancient Guardian - the only entity capable of closing the seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line36: But beware! The mere presence of the Ancient Seal summons foul plagues upon your settlement.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line37: Every storm season, a new plague will be unleashed, hindering your efforts to resurrect the Guardian.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line38: To oppose the tormenting force of the plagues, you can construct a Beacon Tower -
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line39: an ancient structure that allows you to summon aid directly from the Smoldering City, and choose up to five one-off abilities.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line40: This concludes our briefing. It’s time for you to put your knowledge into practice.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line41: Reforging each seal will not only grant you the Queen's appreciation and extra resources. It will also push back the Blightstorm and prolong the cycle permanently.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line42: It will be back. It always is. And yet, the horizon gleams with the promise of a brighter future.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line43: I'm counting on you, Viceroys. May the Storm be gentle on you!
