MetaReward_FarmingSpeed_Desc: You gain a permanent +10% boost to farming speed.
MetaReward_FarmRange_Desc: All your farms have their range increased by 1 tile.
MetaReward_FertileSoil_Desc: Permanently increases your chance of finding fertile soil in newly discovered glades.
MetaReward_FoodStockpiles_Desc: The most commonly traded goods in the kingdom. Used as currency in the Smoldering City.
MetaReward_FoxHouseUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade Fox Houses.
MetaReward_FrogHouseUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade Frog Houses.
MetaReward_GladeEventTime_Desc: You gain a permanent 10% bonus to the speed at which scouts work on Glade Events.
MetaReward_GlobalCapacity_Desc: Every worker in your settlement gets a permanent +1 to their carry capacity.
MetaReward_GoalsUnlock_Description: A place where records about great viceroys are kept. Unlocks Deeds.
MetaReward_GracePeriod_Desc: You gain +30s of time after reaching maximum Impatience to try and save your settlement.
MetaReward_GreenFaction_Desc: You can set up trade routes with First Dawn representatives in the Smoldering City.
MetaReward_GuaranteedGoods_Desc: Every settlement starts with additional resources: {2} {0}.
MetaReward_GuaranteedVillager_Desc: Every settlement starts with one more villager.
MetaReward_HarpyHouseUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade Harpy Houses.
MetaReward_HearthServices_Desc: You can expand the Main Hearth with the Commons - a shared space where villagers fulfill service needs, though with a smaller Resolve bonus than in dedicated buildings.
MetaReward_Home_AncientTablet_Desc: One of many inscribed tablets left behind by the Ancients. This particular one seems to describe a mysterious floating island...
MetaReward_Home_Artifact_Desc: The Ancients left behind many strange artifacts, their original purpose shrouded in mystery. Today, these relics serve as a currency in the kingdom, and are highly sought after by scholars.
MetaReward_Home_Cat_Desc: A cunning and elusive subspecies of cat, Sea Tigers are more likely to be seen in the opulent menageries of the Merchant Guild than in their natural habitat of the Coral Forest.
MetaReward_Home_CoralPlant_Desc: A pleasantly fragrant plant plucked from the heart of the Coral Forest. Despite its delicate appearance, its leaves are as strong as stone.
MetaReward_Home_Crystal_Desc: Sparkdew crystals, born from decades of rain-soaked sediment accumulation, are one of the most crucial components used in the creation of Rain Engines.
MetaReward_Home_Flamethrower_Desc: Created by the ingenious minds of the Brass Order, this device is a testament to our progress. It's hard to imagine how our ancestors dealt with Blightrot without the aid of such a marvelous invention.
MetaReward_Home_Food_Desc: A plate decorated with freshly-baked stormseed bread and a medley of exotic fruits - dewberries, stormshade apples, and ripe raindrop cherries.
MetaReward_Home_Letters_Desc: The Merchant Guild frequently reaches out to new Viceroys, alluring them with the promise of "mutually beneficial" trade agreements that are often too tempting to refuse.
MetaReward_Home_MarshlandsPlant_Desc: Why not bring an invasive species of fungus into your home? What could possibly go wrong...
MetaReward_Home_MoleTrophy_Desc: The head of a young Drainage Mole. For years, scholars have wondered whether these strange creatures formed subterranean societies or built primitive settlements beneath our feet.
MetaReward_Home_MoorlandsPlant_Desc: Cherished for its delicate beauty, this rare flower has long been the symbol of love among the people of the Citadel.
MetaReward_Home_Painting2_Desc: The origins of the Hearths remain shrouded in mystery, their builders and purpose lost to time. What is certain, however, is their profound antiquity and their unique connection to the Holy Flame.
MetaReward_Home_Painting3_Desc: Looking at this painting, one has to wonder - has the world always been like this? Has there always been endless rain and relentless storms?
MetaReward_Home_Rug_Desc: An authentic Ibex rug, meticulously crafted using traditional techniques. How did it end up in this part of the kingdom?
MetaReward_Home_Skull_Desc: Scholars have long tried to learn more about the Fishmen, but every attempt to contact them has ended tragically. For now, their origins, culture, and allegiance to the Sealed Ones remain a mystery.
MetaReward_Home_StormOrb_Desc: A mysterious crystal ball with a Stormbird feather suspended inside. Tiny bolts of lightning dance within, tracing intricate patterns across its curved walls.
MetaReward_Home_Umbrella_Desc: Combining the functions of an umbrella, lance, sword, and shield into one remarkable device, the Dueling Umbrella is considered one of the most valuable and versatile weapons in existence.
MetaReward_Home_UniformBase_Desc: The quintessential uniform worn by nearly every Viceroy, designed to withstand even the heaviest of downpours.
MetaReward_Home_UniformP10_Desc: Intricate ornaments designed to be attached to a settler's mask. Their shape resembles outstretched phoenix wings.
MetaReward_Home_UniformP15_Desc: An outfit meant only for the highest-ranking Viceroys in the kingdom. Handcrafted from the finest fabrics, reinforced with Leviathan leather, and dyed using a rare Blight-infused pigment.
MetaReward_Home_UniformP20_Desc: The Viceroy's cape in royal red. A truly rare sight within the Citadel, as this exclusive honor is bestowed only upon a select few Viceroys by the crown.
MetaReward_Home_UniformP5_Desc: A sturdy and ornate belt made from extremely durable Drainage Mole leather. It is designed to hold numerous insignia.
MetaReward_Home_UniformPioneer_Desc: A ceremonial garb given only to long-serving Viceroys. Made by the finest harpy tailors in the kingdom.
MetaReward_Home_UniformQueensHand_Desc: The traditional emblem of the Queen's Hands - a remarkably resilient yet lightweight pauldron, forged in the heart of the Citadel, within the very caldera of Red Mountain itself.
MetaReward_Home_UniformSettler_Desc: Beneath the mask, your identity fades into insignificance. All that matters is your unwavering service to the kingdom.
MetaReward_Home_UniformVeteran_Desc: While Viceroys no longer engage in combat, their uniform still pays homage to the traditional attire worn by the early explorers of the realm.
MetaReward_Home_UniformViceroy_Desc: An ornate cape adorned with the kingdom's emblem. Wearing it is a privilege reserved for seasoned Viceroys who have successfully overseen many settlements.
MetaReward_HubTier1_Desc: You can upgrade your Hearths to the Neighborhood level.
MetaReward_HubTier2_Desc: You can upgrade Hearths to the District level.
MetaReward_HumanHouseUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade Human Houses.
MetaReward_Impatience_Desc: You gain a permanent -2% to the speed at which the Queen's Impatience grows.
MetaReward_LizardHouseUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade Lizard Houses.
MetaReward_Machinery_Desc: Salvaged remains of Rainpunk technology. Used as currency in the Smoldering City.
MetaReward_MainWarehouseHaulers_Desc: You can assign villagers to the Main Warehouse to work as dedicated haulers.
MetaReward_MenuSkin_Generic_Desc: A new skin for your main menu. You can change skins in the Options menu, under the "Menu Skin" setting.
MetaReward_MetaResources_Desc: You gain +10% more Citadel Resources whenever you finish a settlement.
MetaReward_MineUpgrades_Desc: Unlocks the ability to upgrade mines and access mining veins on deeper levels.
MetaReward_NewcomerGoods_Desc: Newcomers arriving in your settlement will bring more resources with them.
MetaReward_NodeCharges_Desc: All gathering nodes get a permanent +1 to available charges.
MetaReward_Nothing_Desc: You really think there's a reward for what you did?
MetaReward_OrangeFaction_Desc: You can set up trade routes with Brass Order representatives in the Smoldering City.
MetaReward_PreparationPoints_Description: You gain +{0} Embarkation Points to spend on resources and bonuses before starting a new settlement.
MetaReward_ProdSpeed_Desc: You gain a permanent +2% boost to global production speed in your settlement.
MetaReward_QueensHandTrial_Desc:
The ultimate test of determination and cunning, reserved for only the most skilled Viceroys.

(Unlocks a new permadeath game mode that can be accessed from the "Profiles" panel in the main menu.)
MetaReward_Rainpunk_Desc: You can extract infused rainwater from geysers located in glades, and use it to power Rain Engines in production buildings to boost their performance.
MetaReward_ReputationRewardPick1_Descrip: You have one additional option to choose from when choosing blueprints as a Reputation reward.
MetaReward_Reshuffle_Desc: Allows you to pay Amber to reroll blueprints offered as Reputation bonuses.
MetaReward_RevealEffect_Description:
Unlocks the Starting Ability of the species: {0}.

{1}. Starting Abilities are applied immediately after a species joins your town for the first time.
MetaReward_SacrificeCost_Desc: Resources sacrificed in the Ancient Hearth burn 10% longer.
MetaReward_SmallWarehouseHaulers_Desc: You can assign villagers to a Small Warehouse to work as dedicated haulers.
MetaReward_TimedOrdersActivation_Desc: Unlocks a pool of difficult, time-sensitive, and highly rewarding orders. They will randomly appear in some order packages from the Queen's Envoy.
MetaReward_TownVision_Desc: All towns unveil more of the World Map. You can see more of the World Map at the beginning of a cycle.
MetaReward_TraderArrival_Desc: You gain a permanent +3% bonus to trader arrival speed.
MetaReward_TraderMerch_Desc: All traders will have +1 cornerstone or blueprint for sale.
MetaReward_TraderMerchSale_Desc: Traders will offer one random perk or blueprint at a 50% discount.
MetaReward_TradeRoutesActivation_Desc: Allows you to establish trade routes with other nearby settlements.
MetaReward_TradeRoutesLimit_Desc: You gain a permanent +1 to the number of trade routes you can have active at once.
MetaReward_TraderPerkDiscount_Desc: You gain a permanent discount of 10% on perks and blueprints sold by traders.
MetaReward_TraderPrices_Desc: You gain a permanent discount of 5% on all wares sold by traders.
MetaReward_VillagerSpeed_Desc: Every villager in your settlement gets a permanent +2% increase in their walking speed.
ModifierEffect_3Orders_Desc: The proximity of a Royal Outpost makes it easier to communicate with the crown. The pool of order choices will increase by 1.
ModifierEffect_AbandonedSettlement_Desc: Another Viceroy tried to settle this area, but unfortunately failed... You start with a small destroyed settlement in your initial glade.
ModifierEffect_AdditionalGrass_Desc: Glades have an increased chance of including fertile soil.
ModifierEffect_CornerstoneLimit_Desc: This place once held great significance for the ancients. Even now, a mysterious guardian still watches over it. You are not allowed to have more than {0} annual or Stormforged Cornerstones at a time.
ModifierEffect_DangerousLands_Desc: Only Dangerous Glades can be found in this region.
ModifierEffect_ForbiddenLands_Desc: Only Forbidden Glades can be found in this region.
ModifierEffect_Frosts_Desc: A bizarre cold rises from below and engulfs the Sacred Flame. Reduces the radius of Hearths by {0} fields.
ModifierEffect_GatheringStorm_Desc: A mysterious force is drawing in heavy clouds. Every year, the storm lasts {0} longer.
ModifierEffect_HostilityPeople_Desc: This region was heavily exploited by other viceroys. Hostility doesn't grow with each passing year, but you'll gain {0} more Hostility Points per villager.
ModifierEffect_InitialHostility_Desc: This land was once the place of a mythical battle. You start with {0} Hostility points.
ModifierEffect_InitialImpatience_Desc: The crown warned you not to settle near giant Sparkdew Crystals. Start with {0} Impatience.
ModifierEffect_LandOfGreed_Desc: The strange totem causes you to only focus on your wealth... And the Crown is worried. Impatience grows {0} quicker, but every ongoing trade route reduces the Impatience generation speed by {1}.
ModifierEffect_LongStorm_Desc: Something is wrong with the weather patterns in this area. +{1} to {0} duration.
ModifierEffect_Move_Desc: The power of a nearby monument makes everything feel lighter. You can move most buildings in your settlement.
ModifierEffect_NoControl_Desc: The Monks of the Holy Flame are a fanatically egalitarian order. You cannot forbid consumption, or favor any species.
ModifierEffect_NoGeysers_Desc: For some reason, even in a world of constant rain, some regions have no underground water reservoirs. This area has no Rainwater Geysers.
ModifierEffect_NoGladeInfo_Desc: Sometimes, viceroys condemn their people to a terrible fate... Dangerous and Forbidden Glade warnings are disabled.
ModifierEffect_NoGoodsRefund_Desc: The rain is especially toxic in this region. No resources will be refunded after destroying a building.
ModifierEffect_NoGrass_Desc: The soil is too acidic. There is no fertile soil anywhere in this region.
ModifierEffect_NoHostility_Desc: The Royal Guard is watching over this region. Discovering glades doesn't increase Hostility.
ModifierEffect_NoLeaving_Desc: Due to a strange curse, villagers with low Resolve can't leave the settlement. None of your villagers will generate Reputation from Resolve.
ModifierEffect_NoOrders_Desc: A holy site for the Fishmen. No envoy dares to pass through here. Orders are disabled.
ModifierEffect_OminousPresence_Desc: Something strange is trapped beneath the ground. Gain twice the Hostility each year, but every time a villager dies or leaves, Hostility decreases by {0} points.
ModifierEffect_OnePerk_Desc: A crumbling statue depicting an unknown species. You can choose from {0} fewer cornerstones.
ModifierEffect_OvergrownLibrary_Desc: A remnant of a bygone era, when royal archivists themselves ventured out into the wilderness in search of knowledge. One of your starting blueprint choices is replaced by a Wildcard (you can choose one blueprint from all unlocked blueprints).
ModifierEffect_PetrifiedNecropolis_Desc: Rocks in this region have a very peculiar shape. And they smell funny... {0} {1}
ModifierEffect_PetrifiedNecropolis_MeatF: Gain {0} for every {1} Stone and Clay produced.
ModifierEffect_PetrifiedNecropolis_Stone: Every time a villager dies you get {0}.
ModifierEffect_RuinedSettlement_Desc: This region was settled very frequently in the past. The chance of finding ruins in glades is much higher.
ModifierEffect_SmallMap_Desc: A region crisscrossed by countless rivers, both large and small. Usable land is scarce, as most of the terrain is either flooded or split by waterways. Your settlement starts on a small, isolated island.
ModifierEffect_Temple_Desc: The Forsaken Gods' blessings can be ambiguous. You have a higher chance of receiving timed orders from the Crown.
ModifierEffect_TradeBlock_Desc: Traders are afraid, and will not visit this area. Neither trading nor trade routes are available.
ModifierEffect_TraderAttack_Desc: An old abandoned armory, left behind after the Great Civil War. No villagers will die when attacking a trader.
ModifierEffect_TreeCuttingTime_Desc: The trees are much sturdier here. Cutting them down takes a lot more time.
ModifierEffect_UntamedWilds_Desc: Nobody has settled in this region for multiple cycles. Every Dangerous and Forbidden Glade contains two threats instead of one (except glades with Archaeological Discoveries in the Scarlet Orchard).
News_ComingSoon_Content_Combined: Against the Storm will soon be available. Add the game to your wishlist and follow to stay up to date!
News_ComingSoon_Content1: Against the Storm will soon be available.
News_ComingSoon_Content2: Add the game to your wishlist and follow to stay up to date!
News_DemoDiscord_Content: Discuss your strategies with the Against the Storm community on the official Discord server. Share your feedback and request new features.
News_EarlyAccess_Content:
Welcome to the Early Access of Against the Storm.
The game is still in active development, so you can expect regular updates with new content. 

Occasionally, you may encounter bugs or other issues. Please report them via the in-game Reporter or share your feedback on our Discord: <style="link"><link="discord">discord.gg/against-the-storm</link></style>

Thank you for embarking on this exciting expedition with us!
News_EarlyAccess_Content_Long:
Greetings, Viceroy!
Welcome to the Early Access of Against the Storm.

The game is still in active development, so you can expect regular updates with new content. We listed the upcoming features on the Roadmap, but you can also request new ones via our <style="link"><link="feedback">Request tool</link></style>

Occasionally, you may encounter bugs or other issues. Please report them via the in-game Reporter or share your feedback on our <style="link"><link="discord">Discord</link></style>

Thank you for embarking on this exciting expedition with us!
News_GhostStag: A Spectral Stag hides in the forest!
News_LivingMatterAtFarmfield_Name: A Blood Flower spawned on a farm field!
News_OutNow_Content: The wait is over! Have fun playing Against the Storm, and join us on Discord to share your feedback.
News_PatchGeneric_Content: A new patch is live! Check out the full list of changes here:
News_PlagueOfFishmen_Name: An event ({0}) spawned in the settlement!
News_StartingBloodFlower: A Spectral Stag hides in the forest!
News_Update016_Content: Take control of your recipes in the new summary panel, and face brand-new Forest Mysteries!
News_Update017_Content: We're introducing changes to the Resolve system to make it more predictable and understandable. Now, you can also create player profiles in the Main Menu.
News_Update018_Content:
Graceful yet bloodthirsty Harpies join the game!

What's new:
• New species
• New buildings
• Species selection
• New perks
• New goods
• New orders
• New relic
• And more
News_Update1_0_Content: In this final Early Access update, we bring you the Queen’s Hand Trials - an ironman mode in which you have just one Cycle to reforge the Adamantine Seal.
News_Update1_0_Content_Long:
In this final Early Access update, we bring you the Queen’s Hand Trials - an ironman mode in which you have just one Cycle to reforge the Adamantine Seal.

We're also introducing various smaller balance changes and fixes.
News_Update1_1_Content: In this update, we bring you four new decorations, custom trader portraits, new event icons, a whole host of UI improvements as requested by the community, and new low-level Orders.
News_Update1_1_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you four new decorations, custom trader portraits, new event icons, a whole host of UI improvements as requested by the community, and new low-level Orders.

We are also introducing numerous bug fixes, localization improvements, and many balance changes.
News_Update1_2_Content: Optimize your settlement using the newly added Trends panel, and upgrade your Blight Post for a better chance of surviving the storm.
News_Update1_2_Content_Long:
Optimize your settlement using the newly added Trends panel, and upgrade your Blight Post for a better chance of surviving the storm. 

This update also includes numerous UI improvements, balance changes, new custom art, new sound effects, various bug fixes, and more.
News_Update1_3_Content: In this update, we bring you a brand new glade event, new cornerstones and perks, an improved (and more precise) tree marking tool, and various balance changes.
News_Update1_3_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you a brand new glade event, new cornerstones and perks, an improved (and more precise) tree marking tool, and various balance changes.
 
We’re also introducing several community-inspired UI improvements, various bug fixes, and many localization enhancements.
News_Update1_4_Content: We're introducing a host of new features, including an all-new fishing system, events in the Encyclopedia, an increased level cap, new Smoldering City upgrades, new buildings, new cornerstones, orders, needs and resources, and major balance changes to nearly every aspect of the game.
News_Update1_4_Content_Long:
We're introducing a host of new features, including an all-new fishing system, events in the Encyclopedia, an increased level cap, new Smoldering City upgrades, new buildings, new cornerstones, orders, needs and resources, and major balance changes to nearly every aspect of the game.

We're also excited to announce that the Keepers of the Stone DLC (which introduces a new species and a new biome) is now available!
News_Update1_5_Content: The update adds a new World Event - Forsaken Town - which challenges you to restore a settlement that has been abandoned by its Viceroy. We also introduce a number of balance changes, quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and more!
News_Update1_5_Content_Long:
The update adds a new World Event - Forsaken Town - which challenges you to restore a settlement that has been abandoned by its Viceroy. We also introduce a number of balance changes, quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and more!

The Keepers of the Stone DLC now also includes a brand new biome - the Ashen Thicket - where you can craft your own cornerstones.
News_Update1_6_Content: Convince the Elder the cataclysm isn't coming and gain a purring ally! We're introducing three new world events, new options for existing events, and a major rebalance of the entire system.
News_Update1_6_Content_Long:
Convince the Elder the cataclysm isn't coming and gain a purring ally! We're introducing three new world events, new options for existing events, and a major rebalance of the entire system. 

This update also brings with it various UI improvements, bug fixes, and balance changes.
News_Update1_7_Content: We’ve introduced balance changes to Cornerstones, Traders, and Orders, along with some art updates to icons and buildings, and multiple quality-of-life features.
News_Update1_7_Content_Long:
We’ve introduced balance changes to Cornerstones, Traders, and Orders, along with some art updates to icons and buildings, and multiple quality-of-life features. 
 
Check settlement and building statistics, mirror buildings (horizontal flip), preview Deed completion for World Map Modifiers, and more!
News_Update1_8_Content: Unlock the Commons to fulfill service needs at the Hearth, buy extra blueprint and cornerstone slots in Prestige games, and prioritize the rewards you receive from Glade Events. We've also reworked internal storage, adjusted Foxes' comfort specialization, and made many other improvements.
News_Update1_8_Content_Long:
Unlock the Commons to fulfill service needs at the Hearth, buy extra blueprint and cornerstone slots in Prestige games, and prioritize the rewards you receive from Glade Events. We've also reworked internal storage, adjusted Foxes' comfort specialization, and made many other improvements.

Also, the new Nightwatchers DLC is now available, introducing playable Bats, two new biomes, new world events, new modifiers, and much more!
News_Update1_9_Content: Grow Salt and Insects on the new Brineworks farm. Encounter three new events, including a Lurker preying in the pond and a Petrified Gargoyle. Enhance your cornerstones in a Small Stormforge and benefit from new and upgraded perks.
News_Update1_9_Content_Long:
Grow Salt and Insects on the new Brineworks farm. Encounter three new events, including a Lurker preying in fishing ponds and a Petrified Gargoyle. Enhance your cornerstones in a Small Stormforge and benefit from new and upgraded perks.

The update also introduces special offers at traders, improvements to the Encyclopedia, balance changes, fixes, and several other additions.
News_Update19_Content: Search for infinite resource nodes on the revamped Marshlands biome, and learn more about the game's mechanics from the updated Help window.
News_Update20_Content: The new update introduces revamped Smoldering City Upgrades, and improvements to the game’s difficulty scaling.
News_Update21_Content: Discover 18 new levels of challenge and gain prestige for completing harder and harder maps.
News_Update22_Content: Get better control of the game with the new overhauled UI, and enjoy the new, improved balance.
News_Update23_Content: Face over 60 new challenges and earn exciting rewards with the newest update to the deeds system.
News_Update24_Content: Gain full control over what’s being consumed in your settlement, and experience the improved and embellished UI.
News_Update25_Header: Get rich with the reworked trade route system, and risk everything trying to complete timed orders.
News_Update26_Content: Explore a revamped World Map, find hidden treasures, compete with factions, and overcome new and exciting challenges.
News_Update27_Content: The new update introduces changes to the routines of villagers, who now fulfill their needs at home. Also, the Queen offers you new and exciting cornerstones!
News_Update28_Content: We’ve introduce a completely new hub system, multiple cornerstones and orders, and 8 new decorations.
News_Update28_Content_Long:
We’ve introduced a completely new hub system, multiple cornerstones and orders, and 8 new decorations. 

Inspired by feedback regarding the system of fulfilling needs at home, we’ve decided to replace it with the hubs system.

Now, villagers fulfill their needs at Hearths which have hub levels. Open the Encyclopedia for more information.
News_Update29_Content: Test your mettle against a new danger spawned by the rain - the Blight.
News_Update29_Content_Long:
Test your mettle against a new danger spawned by the rain - the Blight.

The pollution caused by Rainpunk technology spawns Blightrot Cysts. They lay dormant at first, and give beneficial effects - but once the storm awakens them, they can cause real harm to your settlement. Build Blight Posts and send Blight Fighters to deal with them. Open the Encyclopedia to learn more.
News_Update30_Content: This update introduces numerous gameplay and interface improvements, as well as the long-awaited new type of cornerstone - the Wildcard.
News_Update30_Content_Long:
This update introduces numerous gameplay and interface improvements, as well as the long-awaited new type of cornerstone - the Wildcard.

We’ve also lengthened the game's duration by increasing the Reputation Points target, visually enhanced the World Map, and fixed a ton of bugs.
News_Update31_Content: Discover a new Glade Event, leverage the revamped sacrifice mechanic in the Hearth, and learn from the new World Map tutorial.
News_Update31_Content_Long:
Discover a new Glade Event, leverage the revamped sacrifice mechanic in the Hearth, and learn from the new World Map tutorial.

We’ve also introduced numerous UI and UX improvements, balance changes, and deeds designed specifically for new players.
News_Update32_Content: Discover the gruesome mysteries of the Cursed Royal Woodlands and play around with the new cornerstone balance.
News_Update32_Content_Long:
Discover the gruesome mysteries of the Cursed Royal Woodlands and play around with the new cornerstone balance. 

Find restless spirits in the forest, fulfill their requests, and collect valuable rewards. But beware - the forest has reshaped itself, and glades are even deadlier than before!
News_Update33_Content: We’ve introduced a new Hearth design, the ability save limits for recipes, new Forest Mysteries, ethereal cornerstones, and further improvements to the tutorial.
News_Update33_Content_Long:
We’ve introduced a new Hearth design, the ability save limits for recipes, new Forest Mysteries, ethereal cornerstones, and further improvements to the tutorial. 

Constructing new Hearths now requires Wildfire Essence (can be acquired from orders, Glade Events, or traders). We’ve also replaced 90+ icons.
News_Update34_Content: Earn achievements, complete new deeds, and get to grips with the new order balancing.
News_Update34_Content_Long:
Earn achievements, complete new deeds, and get to grips with the new order balancing. 

We’ve also added the option to prioritize recipes and select multiple ingredients for each recipe.
News_Update35_Content: Discover new events hidden in the forest, strike a shady deal with the Trickster, and rebuild haunted ruins to gain access to more powerful versions of buildings.
News_Update35_Content_Long:
Discover new events hidden in the forest, strike a shady deal with the Trickster, and rebuild haunted ruins to gain access to more powerful versions of buildings. 

This update also brings with it numerous UI improvements, refreshed resource node models, and new farming animations.
News_Update36_Content: Delve into the reworked mines and invest resources to reach their deepest levels.
News_Update36_Content_Long:
Delve into the reworked mines and invest resources to reach their deepest levels.

Mines can now be upgraded and ore deposits are depletable. We also present numerous fixes, UX improvements, and balance changes.
News_Update37_Content: Earn generous rewards for unearthing ancient skeletons. We introduce a new unique biome mechanic and visual revamp of the Scarlet Orchard!
News_Update37_Content_Long:
Earn generous rewards for unearthing ancient skeletons. We introduce a new unique biome mechanic and visual revamp of the Scarlet Orchard!

A new essential building is now available when playing in the Scarlet Orchard - the Archaeologist's Office. The update also includes multiple fixes and improvements inspired by your feedback.
News_Update38_Content: Discover new glade events, place large decorations, and complete brand-new deeds.
News_Update38_Content_Long:
Discover new glade events, place large decorations, and complete brand-new deeds.

We also introduce balance changes to the Scarlet Orchard and multiple UI improvements based on community feedback.
News_Update39_Content: Try out the new small camps, and experience the new balance of biomes and glades. Small camps are available in every game, and can gather small (1x1) resource nodes.
News_Update39_Content_Long:
Try out the new small camps, and experience the new balance of biomes and glades. Small camps are available in every game, and can gather small (1x1) resource nodes.

We’ve also introduced a wide array of changes to rewards and perk balances, as well as numerous UI and UX improvements.
News_Update40_Content: We're introducing overhauled visuals for camps, new cornerstones, changes to newcomer caravans, and numerous UX improvements.
News_Update40_Content_Long:
We're introducing overhauled visuals for camps, new cornerstones, changes to newcomer caravans, and numerous UX improvements.

The Ancient Hearth and Warehouse's positions now differ every game, and you can manually set a building's internal storage limit.
News_Update41_Content: Test your mettle and improve your skills in the new custom game mode - Training Expeditions.
News_Update41_Content_Long:
Test your mettle and improve your skills in the new custom game mode - Training Expeditions.

On a Training Expedition, you can choose any set of starting conditions and customize game settings. To unlock custom games, upgrade the Obsidian Archive in the Smoldering City.
News_Update42_Content: This update features a brand new game mechanic called Rainpunk, as well as a long-awaited overhaul to the Blightrot system.
News_Update42_Content_Long:
This update features a brand new game mechanic called Rainpunk, as well as a long-awaited overhaul to the Blightrot system.

You can now collect infused rainwater and utilize it in Rain Engines to boost production in your buildings. But beware - this new technology might cause a lot of trouble in your settlement, so your Blight Fighters better be ready!
News_Update43_Content: In this update, we expand the Rainpunk system by revamping the Rain Collector and adding new events, Forest Mysteries, and Cornerstones.
News_Update43_Content_Long:
In this update, we expand the Rainpunk system by revamping the Rain Collector and adding new events, Forest Mysteries, and Cornerstones.

We also improve the balance of Pipes and Rainwater, add numerous UI improvements, and introduce a new building - the Advanced Rain Collector.
News_Update44_Content: This update introduces changes to the favoring mechanic and to settlement logistics. We’ve also added a new Glade Event - the Altar of Decay.
News_Update44_Content_Long:
This update introduces changes to the favoring mechanic and to settlement logistics. We’ve also added a new Glade Event - the Altar of Decay.

There are also numerous balance changes to Cornerstones and Events, as well as some UI improvements and bug fixes.
News_Update45_Content: In this update, we introduce 8 new World Map Modifiers, inspired by a recent Community Brainstorm. We also introduce numerous UX improvements.
News_Update45_Content_Long:
In this update, we introduce 8 new World Map Modifiers, inspired by a recent Community Brainstorm. We also introduce numerous UX improvements.

The most notable of these are the effect previews for retroactive Cornerstones and Trade Route UI changes. We also rebalanced a number of Orders and fixed a lot of bugs.
News_Update46_Content: Twitch integration introduces brand-new ways in which streamers can interact with their audience: a chat minigame and chat voting.
News_Update46_Content_Long:
Twitch integration introduces brand-new ways in which streamers can interact with their audience: a chat minigame and chat voting.

The update also features fuel prioritization, Forest Mystery and Order balance, graphical optimizations, and more!
News_Update48_Content: In this massive new update, we introduce a 5th playable species: Foxes. The update also brings with it 5 new buildings, new orders, new events, a new food type, new upgrades, and a level cap increase.
News_Update48_Content_Long:
In this massive new update, we introduce a 5th playable species: Foxes. The update also brings with it 5 new buildings, new orders, new events, a new food type, new upgrades, and a level cap increase.

We also introduce unique starting abilities for each species, and deliver changes to the Hunger system with Hunger stack thresholds for each species.

To unlock Foxes, you must reach level 10.
News_Update49_Content: In this update, we introduce a new glade event, the Merchant Shipwreck, as well as 6 new ghost encounters in the Cursed Royal Woodlands, 7 new orders, and 8 new deeds.
News_Update49_Content_Long:
In this update, we introduce a new glade event, the Merchant Shipwreck, as well as 6 new ghost encounters in the Cursed Royal Woodlands, 7 new orders, and 8 new deeds.

We also changed how standing levels progress on trade routes, added new decisions to already existing events, implemented numerous UX improvements, and fixed a lot of bugs.
News_Update50_Content: Explore small glades and discover elusive Treasure Stags, three new traders with four unique perks in store, and the Rainpunk Drill that spawns valuable ore nodes.
News_Update50_Content_Long:
Explore small glades and discover elusive Treasure Stags, three new traders with four unique perks in store, and the Rainpunk Drill that spawns valuable ore nodes.

The update also introduces balance changes, UX improvements, and bug fixes.
News_Update51_Content: In this update, we bring you a new glade event - a prophetic Fishman Soothsayer - and numerous balance changes to trading, rainwater production, and mining.
News_Update51_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you a new glade event - a prophetic Fishman Soothsayer - and numerous balance changes to trading, rainwater production, and mining.

We’ve also made some UI improvements, including changes to the Embark Panel, ruin highlights in the resource tooltip, and a perk label cleanup.
News_Update52_Content: In this update, we’re bringing you some long-awaited gameplay and interface improvements, such as a game history screen, a Citadel summary view, a button to unassign all woodcutters, and shortcuts for buildings.
News_Update52_Content_Long:
In this update, we’re bringing you some long-awaited gameplay and interface improvements, such as a game history screen, a Citadel summary view, a button to unassign all woodcutters, and shortcuts for buildings.

We’ve also introduced numerous balance changes to service buildings, Stormforged Cornerstones, regular perks, and level up rewards.
News_Update53_Content: Embark on a cycle-long journey toward the Ancient Seals. Grow your caravan, solve world map events, and plan your route towards the ultimate goal.
News_Update53_Content_Long:
Embark on a cycle-long journey toward the Ancient Seals. Grow your caravan, solve world map events, and plan your route towards the ultimate goal.

This update marks the first step of our extensive revamp of the meta layer, and lays the groundwork for exciting new things to come in the future.
News_Update54_Content: In this update, we bring you 5 new World Events, and numerous UI improvements to the recently revamped Blightstorm Cycle.
News_Update54_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you 5 new World Events, and numerous UI improvements to the recently revamped Blightstorm Cycle.

We also introduce various balance changes, new icons, custom illustrations, and sounds for some World Events, along with a lot of bug fixes.
News_Update55_Content: We introduce a new tool to help you keep track of all the recurring payments from Forest Mysteries, Modifiers, and perks.
News_Update55_Content_Long:
We introduce a new tool to help you keep track of all the recurring payments from Forest Mysteries, Modifiers, and perks.

The update also brings balance changes to the cornerstones and multiple UX improvements, such as matching the Trader's offer and resource sacrifice auto-termination after the Storm.
News_Update56_Content: Upgrade species houses to gain valuable effects and forge new strategies using brand-new Legendary Cornerstones.
News_Update56_Content_Long:
Upgrade species houses to gain valuable effects and forge new strategies using brand-new Legendary Cornerstones.

We also introduce new Citadel Upgrades, numerous UI improvements, balance changes, and a lot of bug fixes.
News_Update57_Content: In this update, we bring you 3 new World Events, Seal Contracts, World Map generation improvements, and the option to track selected resources on the HUD.
News_Update57_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you 3 new World Events, Seal Contracts, World Map generation improvements, and the option to track selected resources on the HUD.

We’ve also introduced numerous balance changes to difficulty levels, perks, timed orders, and glade events.
News_Update58_Content: Venture into the revamped Sealed Forest - a mysterious and hostile biome with unique mechanics and a completely new win condition.
News_Update58_Content_Long:
Venture into the revamped Sealed Forest - a mysterious and hostile biome with unique mechanics and a completely new win condition.

Withstand terrible plagues and use the new Beacon Tower building to summon aid directly from the Citadel. Find and collect the lost fragments of the Ancient Guardian to summon it and close the broken seal once and for all.
News_Update59_Content: This update introduces a brand new type of building, the Hauler Station, making transporting resources within the settlement a lot easier.
News_Update59_Content_Long:
This update introduces a brand new type of building, the Hauler Station, making transporting resources within the settlement a lot easier.

We also bring you a lot of UI improvements, balance changes, and some polish to the recently released Sealed Forest biome.
News_Update60_Content: In this update, we’ve moved the hauler profession from the Hauler Station to Warehouses. We’ve also introduced numerous new perks and Forest Mysteries.
News_Update60_Content_Long:
In this update, we’ve moved the hauler profession from the Hauler Station to Warehouses. We’ve also introduced numerous new perks and Forest Mysteries.

There are also multiple UI improvements (like reserving goods at the Main Warehouse), and some much needed balance changes to Cornerstones, Blueprints, and Citadel Upgrades.
News_Update61_Content: Move into your new home in the Smoldering City and give a warm welcome to Aunt Lori - your trusty guide and mentor.
News_Update61_Content_Long:
Move into your new home in the Smoldering City and give a warm welcome to Aunt Lori - your trusty guide and mentor.

In this update, we're introducing a brand-new guidance system and establishing the groundwork for future progression - all centered around your home in the Smoldering City.
News_Update62_Content: Cozy up in your home by collecting keepsakes awarded for completing deeds and climbing up through the Viceroys' ranks. Discuss new topics with Aunt Lori, and seek her advice for your upcoming ventures into the Sealed Forest.
News_Update62_Content_Long:
Cozy up in your home by collecting keepsakes awarded for completing deeds and climbing up through the Viceroys' ranks. Discuss new topics with Aunt Lori, and seek her advice for your upcoming ventures into the Sealed Forest.

The update also introduces numerous balance changes, bug fixes, and some handy quality of life features.
News_Update63_Content: In this update, we bring you two new optional tutorial missions explaining trading, Hostility, Rainpunk, and Blightrot.
News_Update63_Content_Long:
In this update, we bring you two new optional tutorial missions explaining trading, Hostility, Rainpunk, and Blightrot.

We also introduce numerous UX improvements, balance changes, new loading tips, and new custom icons.
News_Update64_Content: In this last update before the 1.0 release, we introduce new achievements, various UI improvements, balance changes (mainly to the Ancient Seal objectives), and much more.
News_Update64_Content_Long:
In this last update before the 1.0 release, we introduce new achievements, various UI improvements, balance changes (mainly to the Ancient Seal objectives), and much more.

Thank you for playing our game, sharing feedback, reporting bugs, and supporting us throughout our Early Access. We are delighted to have shared this amazing time with you. May fortune always favor you, Viceroys!

News_UpdateGeneric_Content_Long: The update also introduces balance changes, UX improvements, and bug fixes.
