Race_Bat_Description: A stern and fiercely devoted people, they take pride in enduring what breaks others and cannot stand being favored. Bats excel at metallurgy (<sprite name="metallurgy">) but find no particular comfort in any type of work.
Race_Bat_Description_Short: A stern and fiercely devoted people, they take pride in enduring what breaks others and cannot stand being favored.
Race_Bat_Passive_Desc_Long:
Gain one stack of Dedication (+1 Bat Resolve) for every 2 members of other species who leave or die. One stack of this effect is removed when a Bat leaves or dies.
Bats can't be favored.
Race_Bat_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Grants the Manorial Court blueprint. This building allows you to banish members of a chosen species to boost the global chance of producing double yields.
Race_Beaver_Description: Beavers are hardworking and honest, but also quite demanding. They are gifted woodworkers (<sprite name="wood">) and enjoy engineering (<sprite name="tech">). Beavers are also known for their innate talent for salesmanship.
Race_Beaver_Description_Short: Beavers are hardworking and honest, but also quite demanding. They excel at woodworking and have an innate talent for salesmanship.
Race_Beaver_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Each neighboring town offers one additional Trade Route option.
Race_Fox_Description: Majestic and mysterious creatures, deeply connected to the forest. They have developed a symbiosis with Blightrot through their long exposure to rainwater. Foxes are skilled scouts (<sprite name="foxforest">) and feel comfortable cooperating with their own kind (<sprite name="cooperation">). They are highly susceptible to starvation, yet are immune to Hostility.
Race_Fox_Description_Short: Majestic and mysterious creatures, deeply connected to the forest. They have developed a symbiosis with Blightrot through their long exposure to rainwater. They are very susceptible to starvation.
Race_Fox_Passive_Desc_Long: Hostility of the Forest does not lower Foxes' Resolve.
Race_Fox_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a Rainwater Geyser in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Frog_Description: A dignified and proud people with a unique affinity for wealth, renowned for their exceptional skills in architecture and their love of water. Shelters do not satisfy them - they require pools of water to feel truly at home. Frogs are skilled masons (<sprite name="stone">) and love working with rainwater (<sprite name="rainwater">).
Race_Frog_Description_Short: A dignified and proud people with a unique affinity for wealth, renowned for their exceptional skills in architecture and their love of water. Shelters do not satisfy them - they require pools of water to feel truly at home.
Race_Frog_Passive_Desc_Long: Frogs don't have a Basic Housing need and don't want to live in Shelters or Big Shelters. They will only move into Frog Houses.
Race_Frog_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a ruin in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Harpy_Description: Harpies are a noble and fragile species, with a primal, aggressive side to them. They have lost their ability to fly due to centuries of exposure to the rain. They excel at alchemy (<sprite name="alchemy">) and love to work with cloth (<sprite name="cloth">).
Race_Harpy_Description_Short: Harpies are a noble and fragile species, with a primal, aggressive side to them. They have lost their ability to fly due to centuries of exposure to the rain.
Race_Human_Description: Humans are a very adaptable species, but they are also very susceptible to the rain. They rely heavily on special clothing, such as their famous rain shells, to keep them dry. Humans are adept at farming (<sprite name="farming">) and really enjoy brewing (<sprite name="brewing">).
Race_Human_Description_Short: Humans are a very adaptable species, but they are also very susceptible to the rain. They rely heavily on special clothing, such as their famous rain shells, to keep them dry.
Race_Human_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a fertile soil patch in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Lizard_Description: Lizards are a very resilient species, but their cold-blooded nature makes them more dependent on fire than any other species. They are very distrustful and religiously believe that true bonds are only forged in battle. They are very good with animals and meat production (<sprite name="meat">), and prefer to work in warm environments (<sprite name="fire">).
Race_Lizard_Description_Short: Lizards are very resilient, but their cold-blooded nature makes them more dependent on fire than any other species. They are very distrustful and religiously believe that true bonds are only forged in battle.
RecipeGrade_Fishing_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency and only allows you to fish in small fishing ponds.
RecipeGrade_Fishing_Grade2_Desc: This recipe is faster and allows you to fish in large fishing ponds.
RecipeGrade_Grade0_Desc: Production uses more resources and takes more time, since this building's equipment is not designed for this task.
RecipeGrade_Grade0_Institution_Desc: This service grants only half the Resolve bonus.
RecipeGrade_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency.
RecipeGrade_Grade1_Institution_Desc: This service grants the full Resolve bonus.
RecipeGrade_Grade2_Desc: This building is properly equipped for the job, reducing production costs slightly.
RecipeGrade_Grade3_Desc: Specialized equipment grants increased yields and shorter production times.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade0_Desc: This recipe has a low efficiency. It's slower, and gatherers will use up {0} charges with each production cycle.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency and only allows you to gather from small gathering nodes.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade2_Desc: This recipe is faster and allows you to gather from large gathering nodes.
Relic_AltarOfDecay_Desc: A sinister stone structure created to worship the Blightrot. Cultists have engraved the inscription: "Nothing escapes death".
Relic_AncientGate_Desc: A strange monument of cyclopean proportions. Heavy storm clouds seem to be gathering around the settlement.
Relic_AncientShrine_T1_Desc: An ominous shrine from a long forgotten era. It's dangerous, but it might hold some ancient knowledge useful to the crown.
Relic_BatBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Bat miners, their tools left where they dropped. It seems they were scouting for a new mining site when something struck them down. The sight of these bodies causes unrest among the Bat population.
Relic_BeaverBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Beaver traders. They were probably assaulted by Fishmen. Or worse... The sight causes anxiety amongst the Beaver population.
Relic_BlightBomb_Desc: A strange humming can be heard from within the ominous device. There's nothing left to do now but detonate it... and hope the results aren't catastrophic.
Relic_Blightrot_Clone_T1_Desc: (Completing a cloned event does not count as completing a Glade Event, and so does not contribute towards perks, deeds, and score).
Relic_Blightrot_T1_Desc: A deadly carrion organism that feeds on decaying matter. It spreads through contaminated rainwater and multiplies with time, becoming more and more dangerous. Blood Flowers are a source of extremely rare resources.
Relic_BlightrotCauldron_Desc: A Rainpunk Cauldron filled with a Blightrot-contaminated liquid. A moving, living fluid spreads around.
Relic_BurrialGrounds_Desc: A strange place filled with gravestones inscribed in an ancient, long forgotten language.
Relic_Camp_Desc: A destroyed camp in the wilderness. There are still survivors in the area.
Relic_Caravan_Desc: A destroyed caravan, stranded in the wilderness. There are drag marks leading deeper into the forest... What could have caused such mayhem?
Relic_Caravan_T1_Desc: A destroyed caravan was found in the newly discovered glade. There are drag marks leading deeper into the forest... What could have caused such mayhem?
Relic_Convicts_Desc: Dangerous convicts from the Smoldering City are hiding in the forest. They somehow managed to free themselves during transport. You can decide their fate - welcome them and employ them in your settlement, or send them back to the Citadel where they will be punished.
Relic_CorruptedCaravana_Desc: A large caravan abandoned in the woods, overgrown with Blightrot Cysts. They must have fed on the transported goods... or people.
Relic_FeastHall_Funeral_Desc: A grand hall built to host magnificent feasts. Constructing it will initiate the Funeral Feast event.
Relic_FishmenCave_Desc: It looks abandoned, but what if it's not? A terrible fishy smell comes from within.
Relic_FishmenLighthouse_Desc: Once upon a time, there must have been a coast and a harbor here. Now this place is haunted by Fishmen and the waters have withdrawn. An ominous light is coming from the top of the lighthouse.
Relic_FishmenOutpost_Desc: Fishmen aren't usually a threat, but they can be a real nuisance after a while.
Relic_FishmenSoothsayer_Desc: An old wandering soothsayer, teeming with magic. He does not speak, though you can hear his voice. His eyes are blank, yet you can feel his gaze. He is not afraid of death, he stands by its side.
Relic_FishmenTotem_Desc: A sinister structure made out of bones. Smells like Fishmen magic.
Relic_ForsakenCrypt_Desc: The Forsaken Crypt hides a frustrated, poor spirit. This place seems to have been plundered a long time ago.
Relic_FoxBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Fox scouts. They must have been sent to search the area to make sure it was safe... Apparently, something stood in their way. This find is causing grief among the Fox population.
Relic_FrogBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Frog architects. It seems they were in the middle of building some sort of monument. The mere sight of these bodies causes unrest among the Frog population.
Relic_FumingMachinery_Desc: Old Rainpunk machinery left unsupervised. Unstable rainwater fumes fill the area.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage1_Desc: The mourners gather in the Feast Hall as the Funerary Feast begins. Following tradition, the guests first partake in a meal, sharing stories and memories of their departed friend.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage2_Desc: After the meal, the funeral guests partake in a customary memorial rite, guiding the soul of the departed toward its journey to a new vessel.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage3_Desc: According to tradition, after the funeral feast, the family of the departed presents small gifts to the guests - tokens to help them remember the friend they have lost.
Relic_Gargoyle_Desc: A weathered stone statue that feels strangely... alive. It seems to shift ever so slightly when no one is watching.
Relic_GenericGhostChest_Converted_Desc: A mysterious chest filled with treasure. It was left behind by a restless spirit as a token of appreciation.
Relic_GenericGhostChest_T1_Desc: The spirit will reward you for fulfilling its last wish. The contents of the chest are unknown.
Relic_Ghost1_Desc: I let us down and was defeated by the Blightrot... but you can avenge me! Kill it with fire!!!
Relic_Ghost1_Name: Ghost of a Blight Fighter Captain
Relic_Ghost10_Desc: I was leading a rebellion against the Queen's tyrannical rule, but the Royal Guard found us. Carry on my legacy!
Relic_Ghost11_Desc: A long time ago, I founded a prosperous settlement. Everything was fine, until one of our scouts discovered something terrifying in the forest. Please, help restore at least a scrap of my legacy.
Relic_Ghost12_Desc: Many viceroys disregard nature. Don't make the same mistake. Be a good example to your people.
Relic_Ghost13_Desc: In these difficult times, beauty helps us forget our troubles. Decorate your village, and your villagers will thank you.
Relic_Ghost14_Desc: Humans deserve to be treated better than the others! Without us, you’d never achieve anything. If you don’t meet our basic needs, we’ll take our revenge!
Relic_Ghost15_Desc: I challenge you, viceroy! Do you consider yourself worthy of the Queen's glance? Prove it. Time is ticking.
Relic_Ghost16_Desc: I'm so sick of these Beavers! They’re the bane of this kingdom! They deserve nothing but condemnation for what they did to us. I order you to torment them - or I'll do it myself!
Relic_Ghost17_Desc: They took our homes and our crops. They desecrated our culture, and in the end, they took our lives. The time of contempt has come.
Relic_Ghost18_Desc: These fanatics should pay for their heresies! They are dangerous, wild, and unpredictable creatures. Teach these savages, once and for all.
Relic_Ghost19_Desc: We will no longer tolerate those upturned beaks roaming the settlement freely. Everyone must learn the truth about how the Harpy alchemists poisoned us to seize power!
Relic_Ghost2_Desc: I have studied the Blightrot all my life. Nobody believes me, but the cysts are essential for the ecosystem! Grow them and find out yourself!
Relic_Ghost20_Desc: Self-righteous Beavers only want to bask in the luxuries we’ve worked so hard for. Time to end this injustice!
Relic_Ghost21_Desc: Greedy Human farmers always want to keep all the crops for themselves. Those traitors hid everything from us, and pretended the crops were rotten!
Relic_Ghost22_Desc: I promised my Queen that I would cleanse this forest of all the horrors that lived here. One night, my mount got frightened by the storm, and we fell into the Fishmen's nets. My mission must be completed!
Relic_Ghost23_Desc: Spread the word about the power of the Holy Fire! Only it can save us from the storm's wrath. Gather the villagers in the chapel and pray!
Relic_Ghost24_Desc: We worked so hard, and put our lives in danger every day. If you don't let your villagers rest, I will make sure your soul never finds peace.
Relic_Ghost25_Desc: If your eyes sparkle at the sight of gold, I have an offer for you. All you have to do is prove that you are one of us, and I will give you my treasure.
Relic_Ghost26_Desc: The foundation of success is a thriving settlement. Without solid walls, you won't survive here. Create something you can be proud of.
Relic_Ghost27_Desc: The last thing I remember is lightning hitting my caravan. The settlements are still waiting for the goods they ordered. If you deliver them, I’ll see that you’re rewarded.
Relic_Ghost28_Desc: Let the fire burn in the Hearth and grow in all its strength. Sacrifice your goods, and help the villagers weather the storm!
Relic_Ghost29_Desc: Our flock has been in mourning for many years. We will never forget the war. Please, rekindle the hope in the Harpies' hearts.
Relic_Ghost3_Desc: I lived in a very prosperous settlement, but our viceroy was greedy and didn't care about the forest at all! In the end, it brought doom upon us. Refrain from greed, and calm the forest.
Relic_Ghost30_Desc: My army fought bravely against all odds. Many of us paid the ultimate price. Please, show your respect to those who survived. I'll take care of the fallen.
Relic_Ghost31_Desc: It was them! I'm sure of it! I remember their blank, blight-tainted gaze! They ambushed me in the forest! Please, avenge me!
Relic_Ghost32_Desc: How could I have gotten lost!? Something's not right here... You! You have to help me!
Relic_Ghost33_Desc: I've lived a long and prosperous life, and I've never let a business opportunity pass me by. Good deals have a nasty habit of vanishing very quickly, so seize them!
Relic_Ghost34_Desc: Hey, you! You're a viceroy, ain't you? Your bastard friends attacked me and left me to die in the woods! Prove to me you're not like them!
Relic_Ghost35_Desc: The everlasting rain is a as much a gift as it is a curse. And yet it made us stronger, more resilient. Embrace it.
Relic_Ghost36_Desc: I was a Teadoctor for years, helping my kind endure the effects of our strange illness. In the end, the disease took me. Take care of my people for me, please.
Relic_Ghost38_Desc: These hands once built sturdy homes from raw stone; now I call upon you to restore and improve them so that they may stand the test of time.
Relic_Ghost39_Desc: In life I was a philosopher and a teacher. Now, in death, I long for those days. So let me teach you - lift the spirits of your people. Nourish their minds and bodies.
Relic_Ghost4_Desc: You hear it? This ominous forest is calling to us... Withstand its fury, and I will spare your settlement.
Relic_Ghost40_Desc: In life I wandered without aim; in death I beg you to spare others the same fate. Build a sanctuary for those who have no roof over their heads.
Relic_Ghost41_Desc: Madness, they said, but genius knows no bounds! Embrace my volatile creations and make these fools tremble at the mere sight of your power!
Relic_Ghost42_Desc: They called me a tyrant for upholding order - for daring to keep the Frog scum in their place. They banished me, left me to rot, and called it justice? Hypocrites, all of them!
Relic_Ghost43_Desc: Fate has a cruel sense of humor - one day you're swinging the axe, the next you're kneeling at the executioner's block.
Relic_Ghost44_Desc: The air turned to poison, and the dark took us all… Please, stranger - don't let this happen again.
Relic_Ghost5_Desc: Those filthy little thieves are heartless! We were starving, and they just watched and laughed in our faces. It has to stop. Teach them a lesson.
Relic_Ghost6_Desc: We cherished the Flame - it enveloped us with its warmth. But suddenly... It went out. I can't remember what happened. Please - you can’t let this happen again! Let the sound of axes echo through the forest.
Relic_Ghost7_Desc: I've had enough of all these uptight do-gooders, with their pristine morals and boring attitudes. It's time to start some trouble!
Relic_Ghost8_Desc: I wish I’d stayed with my loved ones in the Citadel. Now, all I'm left with is regret. Don't follow in my footsteps. Be kind to those around you.
Relic_Ghost9_Desc: Nothing matters except the Queen. It is an honor to serve her. Show how loyal you are. Otherwise, I will have to punish you.
Relic_GhostStag_Desc: A truly rare sight - a Spectral Treasure Stag, lured to this place by the lingering anguish of mortal souls. Those who manage to find it will be rewarded with a special treasure.
Relic_GladeTrader_Hermit_Desc: The Hermit rarely visits royal settlements, and actively avoids the Crown's officials. But he seems eager to trade with you.
Relic_GladeTrader_Seer_Desc: A strange woman is observing the settlement from afar.
Relic_GladeTrader_Shaman_Desc: A mysterious and imposing figure has been spotted near the settlement. He is pulling a wagon full of herbs and ointments.
Relic_GoldStag_Desc: Its elusive nature allows it to move like a ghost through the foggy thicket. It is believed that the beast is tied to the spirit world and the Ancestors. A special treasure awaits the one who finds it.
Relic_HarmonyAltar_Desc: An old altar found in the wilds. The ancient language carved into the stone proclaims: "Light a fire at the altar to gain the blessing of the Spirit of Harmony".
Relic_HarmonyAltarPositive_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> When your villagers' needs are met, Harmony is fostered. Each unique service building adds 2 to Global Resolve.
Relic_HarpyBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Harpy scientists... The sight causes unrest amongst the Harpy population.
Relic_HumanBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Human explorers. They were probably looking for a place to settle, far from the Queen's watchful eyes... The sight causes uneasiness amongst the Human population.
Relic_InfectedMole_Desc: One of the mythical guardians of the forest - still alive, but plagued by a mysterious disease. The Blightrot has taken over his mind, causing an unstoppable rage. You can try to heal him... or whisper prayers to its new masters.
Relic_InfectedTree_Desc: The once mighty tree has been deformed by the Blightrot living in its root system. The Blightrot poisons the tree's tissues, leading to its long-lasting degradation.
Relic_Kelpie_Desc: A legendary, shape-shifting aquatic spirit that lurks near water and mesmerizes travelers. It is said that whoever acquires the kelpie's bridle will be able to control it.
Relic_LeakingCauldron_Desc: An old, broken piece of Rainpunk technology. It's contaminating the soil around it.
Relic_LightningCatcher_Desc: A weird contraption that attracts lightning. Its proximity to the settlement might have grave consequences.
Relic_LizardBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Lizard hunters... The sight causes unrest amongst the Lizard population.
Relic_MerchantShipWreck_Desc: How powerful must the storm surge have been to carry this shattered wreck all the way here? Perhaps in the distant past, there was a sea here? It looks as if it’s been lying here for centuries. Strange voices can be heard coming from below deck...
Relic_Mistworm_T1_Desc: A small, yet dangerous creature. It normally lives underground or hides in the mist, but this one seems to be more courageous than its kin.
Relic_Mole_Desc: A wild beast that usually lives underground. It was forced to the surface for some reason.
Relic_Monolith_Desc: A mystical stone monument. Unknown runes are carved all over its surface.
Relic_NoxiousMachinery_Desc: A damaged and abandoned rainpunk contraption. The area was probably deserted because of a significant explosion risk. The machine's valves emit a distinct Blightrot odor.
Relic_PetrifiedTree_T1_Desc: A strange tree that’s been turned to stone by the rain. It's radiating its sickness to the other trees around it.
Relic_RainpunkDrill_Desc: One of the Brass Order's curious little inventions. It appears to be broken.
Relic_RainpunkFactory_Desc: An old, abandoned piece of advanced Rainpunk technology. It seems extremely unstable - but maybe it can be rebuilt...
Relic_RainTotem_Desc: A totem built by the Fishmen. It seems to have affected the weather, making the rain heavier.
Relic_RewardChest_Desc: An abandoned cache of goods. This could be a lost shipment - or something much more valuable.
Relic_ScorpionReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> Legend has it that they once inhabited the top of the mountain on which the Smoldering City now stands. The Queen banished them, but it is said that some of them still hibernate somewhere on the outskirts of the kingdom.
Relic_ScorpionStage1_Desc: Royal archaeologists are certain that a phenomenal discovery is hidden here. The Queen offers a generous reward for unearthing this ancient skeleton. This event is multi-stage and includes excavation, conservation, and reconstruction of the skeleton.
Relic_ScorpionStage2_Desc: After successfully excavating most of the ancient bones, they now need to be carefully conserved before proceeding to the reconstruction stage. However, the creature has not yet been identified.
Relic_ScorpionStage3_Desc: Archaeologists are ready to begin the final stage - reconstruction. A mythical creature is finally being unearthed. Huge bones are put together, revealing the full form of the monster that once inhabited this land.
Relic_SealedTombT2_Desc: An open entrance to an ancient dungeon. Strange sounds can be heard coming from inside.
Relic_SnakeReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> This beast's anatomy is suited to both land and water, making it a deadly hunter of caravans and lost settlers. For some reason, its remains bear traces of Blightrot. Could it have brought this plague to the surface from the depths of the ocean?
Relic_SpiderReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> Once faithful servants of the Sealed Ones, these creatures have been imprisoned underground with their masters. Yet miners still whisper of giant spiders emerging from deep caves to prey on the unwary. Only one thing is said to frighten them - the Holy Flame.
Relic_Stag_BeforeRunning_Desc: A patron of the spirit world. Once discovered, it flees to a nearby Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">). It is said that a special treasure awaits the one who captures it.
Relic_Stormbird_Desc: A never-before encountered Stormbird subspecies. She is fiercely guarding her nest. The clouds around the settlement have begun to darken...
Relic_Stormforge_Desc: This small ancient cornerstone forge seems to have been twisted by some malevolent force, now serving a much darker purpose.
Relic_Temple_Desc: Who would worship the sun in a world with so little sunlight?
Relic_Termite_Desc: An aggressive, parasitic species, able to eat and digest even the hardest materials.
Relic_TotemOfDenial_Desc: A religious structure built by the Fishmen. It interferes with the Hearth in the center of the settlement.
Relic_ToxicSlug_Desc: A bizarre creature that dwells deep underground, in vast networks of water-filled caverns. On rare occasions, it finds its way to the surface, lurking in small reservoirs and preying on unsuspecting fishermen.
Relic_TradersCemetery_Desc: A cemetery full of traders killed by desperate viceroys. What drove them to commit such heinous crimes? Was it out of greed, or necessity?
Relic_WarBeastCage_Desc: A destroyed royal guard camp. It looks as if one of their warbeasts got out and razed the entire encampment to the ground. The beast, usually obedient to its masters, must have been provoked by something.
Relic_Wildfire_Desc: A wildfire spirit. It will wreak havoc on the settlement if it's not contained.
ReputationPenaltyRate_HearthEffect_Human: Human firekeepers create a special link with the Citadel. Impatience grows {0} slower.
ResolveEffect_AgriculturePenalty_Descrip: New farming methods are very effective, but cause a lot of pollution.
ResolveEffect_AncientArtifact_Descriptio: A strange device left behind by the Great Civilization. When soaked in rainwater, it radiates warm light and brings encouragement to those around it.
ResolveEffect_AnyHousingEffect_Descripti: Most species require at least basic shelter from the constant rainfall and gusting winds.
ResolveEffect_BatFactionSupport_Descript: Bats have always been wary and somewhat hostile, but you've proven yourself worthy of their trust.
ResolveEffect_BatHousingEffect_Desc: Bats prefer to live in spacious and dark homes. Bat Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_BatsDedication_Desc: Bats take pride in surviving what breaks other species.
ResolveEffect_BattlegroundPenalty_Desc: Seeing their fallen kin has taken its toll on the villagers.
ResolveEffect_BeaverHousingEffect_Descri: Beavers prefer to live in cozy, wooden homes. Beaver Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_BeaverResolveWine_Desc: The settlement specializes in wine production, and Beavers love that.
ResolveEffect_BeaversFactionSupport_Desc: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Beaver clan remembers your help.
ResolveEffect_BiscuitsEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] biscuits"> biscuits. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_BlazingFire(Coal)_Descript: A roaring magical fire purifies the forest, making the ancient hearth glow like a beacon in the darkness.
ResolveEffect_BlazingFire(GlowOil)_Descr: A roaring magical fire purifies the forest, making the ancient hearth glow like a beacon in the darkness.
ResolveEffect_BlazingFire(Wood)_Descript: Darkness flees before the might of the fire.
ResolveEffect_BloodthirstEffect_Descript: Requires <sprite name="[needs] training gear"> training gear. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_BootsEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[needs] boots"> boots. Satisfying this need grants a movement speed bonus.
ResolveEffect_CityRenown_Description: The city is becoming known among folk as a great place to live.
ResolveEffect_CleanlinessEffect_Desc: Harpies have an innate need to take care of themselves.
ResolveEffect_ClothesEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[needs] coats"> coats. Satisfying this need grants a Resolve bonus during the storm.
ResolveEffect_CreepingShadows_Desc: People fear the unknown during the storm.
ResolveEffect_DevastatingStorms_Desc: The rampaging storm stifles the spirit of all living creatures.
ResolveEffect_EducationEffect_Descriptio: It requires <sprite name="[needs] scrolls"> scrolls. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_EqualProhibitionPenalty_De: No one likes being denied the fruits of their own labor.
ResolveEffect_ExplorersBoredom_Descripti: Who would have thought that great explorers are not so great at planting mushrooms?
ResolveEffect_ExtremeNoise_Description: Working in a loud environment is really taxing.
ResolveEffect_FavoringEffect_Description: Favoritism can be beneficial in the short term, but it's not a viable solution to the village's problems.
ResolveEffect_ForsakenCryptResolveEffect: The ghost from the Forsaken Crypt is threatening the villagers.
ResolveEffect_FoxesFactionSupport_Descri: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Fox tribe remembers your help.
ResolveEffect_FoxesHousingEffect_Descrip: Foxes prefer to live in wooden, well camouflaged houses. Fox Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_FrighteningVisionsResolveE: Villagers are haunted by terrifying visions.
ResolveEffect_FrogHousesBonusResolve_Des: This seemingly extravagant luxury is something that Frogs need to survive.
ResolveEffect_FrogHousingEffect_Descript: Frogs are at home in water. Frog Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_FrogsFactionSupport_Desc: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Frogs remember your help.
ResolveEffect_Frustrated_Desc: Villagers with this effect have a -2 penalty to their Resolve.
ResolveEffect_GladesResolveInDrizzle_Des: People are willing to venture into the wilds and explore.
ResolveEffect_HarmonyAltarPositive_Desc: When your villagers' needs are met, Harmony is fostered.
ResolveEffect_HarpyFactionSupport_Descri: The Flock was neutral during the Great Civil War, but you've proven your worth to them now.
ResolveEffect_HarpyHousingEffect_Desc: Harpies prefer to live in well-lit, spacious homes. Harpy Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_HarpyResolveBalm_Desc: High cosmetic production is boosting Harpies' morale.
ResolveEffect_HarpyResolveTea_Desc: High tea production is boosting Harpies' morale.
ResolveEffect_HarpyStormbirdResolve_Desc: An exceptionally strong bond has developed between the Harpies and the Stormbird. They look very pleased to be in its presence.
ResolveEffect_HearthEffect_Lizard_Desc: Lizard firekeepers are very adept at ancient rites.
ResolveEffect_Hostility_Description_Form: People are growing more anxious ({0} to Global Resolve).
ResolveEffect_HotSprings_Desc: The warmth around the hot geyser improves the mood of the Pump Operators.
ResolveEffect_HousesBonusResolve_Desc: A small reminder of the Holy Flame.
ResolveEffect_HumanHousingEffect_Descrip: Humans prefer to live in solid, safe homes. Human Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_HumanResolveIncense_Desc: A sweet aroma is spreading around the settlement. It seems to be making the Humans feel content.
ResolveEffect_HumansFactionSupport_Descr: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Humans remember your help.
ResolveEffect_HungerPenalty_Description: People are starving. This effect stacks every time a villager doesn't eat during a break.
ResolveEffect_JerkyEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] jerky"> jerky. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_JoyOfDiscovery_Description: There’s something truly magical about setting one's foot in a place that’s been hidden for millennia.
ResolveEffect_LeasiureEffect_Description: It requires <sprite name="[needs] ale"> ale. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_LizardHousingEffect_Descri: Lizards prefer to live in warm, dry homes. Lizard Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_LizardResolveTrainingGear_: A settlement specialized in training gear production makes Lizards feel safe.
ResolveEffect_LizardsFactionSupport_Desc: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Lizard elders remember your help.
ResolveEffect_LuxuryEffect_Description: It requires <sprite name="[needs] wine"> wine. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_MineInStorm_Desc: A strange chant is frightening the villagers.
ResolveEffect_MoleResolvePenalty_Desc: Villagers are afraid of going into the woods.
ResolveEffect_Motivated_Desc: Villagers with this effect have a +1 boost to their Resolve.
ResolveEffect_NewYearPenalty_Description: The forest is becoming more dangerous with each passing year... the people are scared.
ResolveEffect_NoFirePenalty_Description: The fire has gone out, and darkness is spreading around the town.
ResolveEffect_PasteEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] paste"> paste. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_PickledEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] pickled goods"> pickled goods. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_PieEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] pie"> pie. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_PorridgeEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] porridge"> porridge. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_RebeliousSpirit_Descriptio: The people are feeling oddly rebellious.
ResolveEffect_ReligionEffect_Description: It requires <sprite name="[needs] incense"> incense. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_ResolveForConsumption_Desc: A surplus of food makes the villagers happy.
ResolveEffect_ResolveForWater_Desc: A pleasant, earthy scent is in the air.
ResolveEffect_SkewerEffect_Description: This need is fulfilled at the Hearth. It requires <sprite name="[food processed] skewers"> skewers. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_SoakedClothes_Description: Villagers with this effect have a -5 penalty to their Resolve.
ResolveEffect_SpicesfromtheCapital_Descr: Spices from the Smoldering City - a favorite of Humans and Lizardfolk.
ResolveEffect_StagBlessing_Desc: The forest god has blessed your villagers. This day will be remembered for generations.
ResolveEffect_StormPenalty_Description: The rampaging storm stifles the spirit of all living creatures. An additional stack of this effect is added for each Hostility level.
ResolveEffect_SurvivorBonding_Descriptio: The people in your settlement have survived many hardships, bringing them closer together.
ResolveEffect_ThrillOfExploration_Desc: The woodcutters' song lifts people's spirits.
ResolveEffect_ToxicFumes_Description: A strange white mist is produced when using Rainpunk technology...
ResolveEffect_TreatmentEffect_Desc: It requires <sprite name="[needs] tea"> tea. Satisfying this need increases the chance of producing double yields.
ResolveEffect_UnfairProhibitionPenalty_D: Villagers get very upset if they are denied things their neighbors can still consume.
ResolveEffect_UnfairTreatmentPenalty_Des: Favoritism can be beneficial in the short term, but it's not a viable solution to the village's problems.
ResolveEffect_VaultResolvePenalty_Desc: Strange voices can be heard coming from the sealed vault.
ResolveEffect_Vitality_Desc: Well-nourished villagers enjoy their good health.
ResolveEffect_Wealth_Desc: The people are enjoying living in a prosperous settlement.
Resource_BayTree_Desc: A very flexible, yet extremely hardy plant. It moves in the wind as if moved by sea waves.
Resource_CaveTree_Desc: A petrified mass of tree vines intertwined with solid volcanic rock.
Resource_ClayDeposit_Description: Soil infused with the essence of the rain.
Resource_CopperveinTree_Desc: A scarlet tree covered in enormous thorns.
Resource_CursedTree_Desc: A bare, rotting tree infested with grubs.
Resource_Dewberries_Description: Fresh and sweet berries, infused by the rain.
Resource_Flax_Description: Resilient plants that are perfect for cloth-making.
Resource_GiantGrain_Desc: A wild type of grain, mutated by an invasive species of fungi.
Resource_GiantMeat_Desc: A giant, dead beast. How did it get here?
Resource_GiantMushroom_Desc: An ancient and mysterious organism. Proto fungi are sometimes referred to as the living and breathing hearts of the Marshlands.
Resource_Herbs_Description: A dense shrub, full of many useful plant species.
Resource_Leather_Description: A leathery exoskeleton left behind by a juvenile water strider. It's better to collect the skin this way than to come across a live, wild specimen.
Resource_LeechNest_Desc: A dead leech broodmother. It has a strong, and somewhat sweet smell.
Resource_MarshStoneDeposit_Description: Stones weathered by the everlasting rain, covered with moss.
Resource_MossBroccoli_Description: An edible and tasty type of moss.
Resource_MushroomDeposit_Description: A resilient species that grows on marshy soil.
Resource_Mushwood_Desc: A giant fungal tree covered in a leathery bark.
Resource_MusselsproutTree_Desc: The unusually hard bark conceals soft, fleshy tissue.
Resource_Plateleaf Tree_Desc: A species of plant rarely seen above water.
Resource_PoroTree_Desc: A lush stalk brimming with sweet sap - a favorite Fluffbeak treat.
Resource_ReedDeposit_Description: A very common plant, it thrives thanks to the magical rain.
Resource_ReptileNest_Desc: A dangerous, but rich source of food and leather.
Resource_RootDeposit_Description: A tangled net of living vines.
Resource_SealedTree_Big_Description: A giant, bizarre growth... it's bigger than the other trees in the area.
Resource_SealedTree_Description: A bizarre, writhing growth... is this even really a tree?
Resource_SnailBroodmother_Description: Small slickshells are crawling out of the openings in the broodmother's shell. It's easy to collect them.
Resource_StoneDeposit_Description: Stones, weathered by the everlasting rain.
Resource_StormbirdNest_Description: An abandoned Drizzlewing nest. These small, flightless birds run away as soon as they spot another living creature nearby.
Resource_SwampWheat_Description: A plant species that’s right at home in the swamp.
Resource_WastelandTree_Desc: A diminished remnant of the legendary giant spruce that once inhabited this region.
Resource_WormtongueNest_Description: A nest full of tasty wormtongues.
Reward_2HaulingCarts_Desc: Two rainpunk hauling carts will be assigned to the Main Warehouse to help transport resources between buildings.
Reward_3CornerstoneRerolls_Desc: Our Queen's benevolence knows no bounds. Gain 3 additional cornerstone reroll charges.
Reward_AccidentalBarrels_Desc: Some woodworkers just can't stop working. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AccidentalBricks_Desc: Nothing goes to waste. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AccidentalJerky_Desc: Top 10 tips on how to cook more efficiently - by Sahilda. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AccidentalOil_Desc: A useful mill upgrade. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AccidentalSkewers_Desc: A mysterious ingredient discovered by the famous chef and businessman Zhorg. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AccidentalWine_Desc: A set of specialized alchemical tools. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Reward_AmberCurse_Desc: The blood of an Ancient was spilled here. <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber is now worth {0} less to traders.
Reward_AmberForLuxury_Desc: Amber is worth {0} more for every {1} villagers with the need for luxury fulfilled.
Reward_AmberforNewcomers_Desc: A joint venture with the Stormwalker Guild can be very profitable. You gain {0} every time you accept a newcomer group from the Citadel, but you’ll lose all stored Amber upon choosing this cornerstone.
Reward_AmberForRelics_Desc: Traders value your efforts in keeping the region safe. Amber is worth {0} more for every completed Dangerous and Forbidden Glade Event.
Reward_AmberForTradeRoutes_Desc: Receive {0} for every {1} completed trade routes.
Reward_AmberForTrading_Altar_Desc: Specializing in a particular branch of commerce can bring a lot of profit. All packs of goods are worth {0} more when sold through trade routes or directly to traders.
Reward_AmberForTrading_Desc: Specializing in a particular branch of commerce can bring a lot of profit. <sprite name="[packs] pack of trade goods"> Packs of trade goods are worth {0} more when sold through trade routes or directly to traders.
Reward_AmberWorthMore_Desc: A golden, sticky substance. It glows when it touches Amber (<sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber is now worth {0} more to traders).
Reward_ArtifactForDangerousRelic_Desc: An odd talisman made from the talons of a phoenix. Gain {0} for every {1} completed Dangerous or Forbidden Glade Events.
Reward_BackToNature_Desc: An old, forbidden ritual. Increases yields by {0} in all buildings that use fertile soil. You will lose all stored food (cooked and raw) upon choosing this cornerstone.
Reward_BackToNatureAltar_Desc: An old, forbidden ritual. Gain {0} more yield in all buildings that use fertile soil.
Reward_BaitForCrafting_Desc: For every {0} units of {1} and {2} used in crafting, gain {3} to bait production when converting a <sprite name="[packs] pack of crops"> pack of crops into ground bait in a fishing hut.
Reward_BatResolveForFrogDeath_Desc: Some old grudges still linger. Bats gain +{0} Resolve for every {1} Frog villagers that leave or die. Global Resolve drops {2} faster.
Reward_BatResolveForFrogDeath_ResolveEff: There’s a certain joy in a well-timed misfortune.
Reward_BeaconEffect_BonusHP_Desc: A powerful connection between the settlement's Hearth and the Citadel. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {0} for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaconEffect_FarmingBoost_Desc: A special delivery from the First Dawn Company. All buildings using fertile soil produce {0} more goods. This effect lasts {1} seasons (including the current season) and must be active during planting to affect harvested crops.
Reward_BeaconEffect_LowerHostility_Desc: A sign from the Queen herself. Hostility is decreased by {0} for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaconEffect_ProductionSpeed_Desc: An energetic, inspiring melody. Global production rate is {0} faster for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaconEffect_SlowerLeaving_Desc: A peaceful song of hope. Villagers with low Resolve will leave the town {0} slower for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaconEffect_TradeRoute_Desc: The clang of a golden bell. All trade routes are {0} faster for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaconEffect_WorkingSpeed_Desc: Looking in the direction of the Citadel, one can see a hopeful glow on the horizon. Scouts work {0} faster on Glade Events for the duration of this season.
Reward_BeaverResolveForHarpies_Desc: High spirits can be contagious. Beavers gain +{0} Resolve for every Reputation Point gained through Harpy Resolve.
Reward_BeaverResolveForWineProd_Desc: The settlement specializes in wine production. Gain +{0} to Beaver Resolve for every {1} produced.
Reward_BiggerStorage_Desc: All buildings have their storage capacity increased by {0}.
Reward_BiomeEffect_AlgaeSacrifice_Acquir: Your villagers seem to have grown accustomed to this bizarre land. You can sacrifice algae in the Ancient Hearth to reduce Hostility.
Reward_BiomeEffect_AlgaeSacrifice_Desc: After using bait {0} times in your fishing huts, you will unlock the ability to sacrifice <sprite name="[mat raw] algae"> algae in the Ancient Hearth to reduce Hostility.
Reward_BiomeEffect_Archaeologist_Desc: Every viceroy embarking on an expedition to the Scarlet Orchard is assigned a royal archaeologist. You gain access to a new essential building: {0}.
Reward_BiomeEffect_BeaconTower_Desc: A blueprint given to you by the Queen herself. This powerful ancient structure will allow you to summon aid directly from the Citadel.
Reward_BiomeEffect_BigTrees_Desc: The flora in this region is bizarrely mutated. Overgrown trees with a lot more resource charges can be found in the forest.
Reward_BiomeEffect_CartsForUsingOre_Desc: The Crown is investing heavily in the region's industrial development. For every {0} units of {1}, {2}, and {3} used in crafting, an automated rainpunk cart will be assigned to one of your warehouses.
Reward_BiomeEffect_DiverseFlora_Desc: Vegetation here mutates into unique strands. Each type of tree provides distinct bonus resources.
Reward_BiomeEffect_ExcavationSites_Desc: A lush and exotic land, filled with prehistoric remains. Ancient excavation sites can be found here.
Reward_BiomeEffect_Forge_Desc: There's an ancient forge in this region that allows its users to create cornerstones. However, you will receive no Epic cornerstones in years 3, 5, and 7.
Reward_BiomeEffect_InspiringPressure_Des: The forest is as scary as it is beautiful. Villagers have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields for each Hostility level.
Reward_BiomeEffect_PoroStartingGlade_Des: These woods are home to Giant Fluffbeaks, who, when properly cared for, produce high-grade fertilizer, allowing you to manually create patches of Fertile Soil.
Reward_BiomeEffect_SealedGlade_Desc: A broken Ancient Seal is hidden somewhere in the forest. To find it, you must first look for clues in the surrounding glades. Its mere presence in this land summons foul plagues upon your settlement during the storm (they are active only during the storm).
Reward_BiomeEffect_ShardsForRelics_Desc: Receive a <sprite name="[valuable] thunderblight shard"> Thunderblight Shard after using {0} mining vein charges (copper, coal, or salt). Up to 3 shards can be gained, requiring 40/80/120 charges.

Reward_StormbirdPositive_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> The nest of a tamed Stormbird. It provides 5 <sprite name="[food raw] eggs"> Eggs per minute and increases Harpy Resolve by +3.
Reward_SunkenTreasure_Generic_Desc: An old, heavy treasure chest covered in algae.
Reward_TradeblockforProdSpeed_Desc: Global production speed is {0} faster, but traders will arrive {1} slower.
Reward_TraderIntervalAttack_Desc: Traders will avoid this settlement if possible and will arrive {0} slower.
Reward_TradeRoutesBonusFuel_Desc: Travel cost on trade routes is reduced by {0}. Doesn't apply to routes already in progress. This effect scales along with the quantity of goods exported.
Reward_TradeRouteSlot_GenericPlural_Desc: You can have {0} more trade routes active at the same time.
Reward_TradeRouteSlot_GenericSingular_De: You can have {0} more trade route active at the same time.
Reward_UpgradeRandomCornerstone_Stormfor: Though forbidden by royal decree, many Viceroys still practice this ancient ritual, and the Crown often turns a blind eye. Upgrades one of your cornerstones to Stormforged rarity, or grants a random one if none qualify.
Reward_VegetablesInGreenhouse_Desc: <sprite name="[food raw] vegetables"> Vegetables ({0}) can now be produced in the Greenhouse.
Reward_WhiteCursedTreasure_Desc: Capturing the mythical White Stag for the Queen will earn you reputation and fame, but the forest will remember this insult.
Reward_WhiteGratitudeGift_Desc: The Royal Treasure Stag offers a moderate increase to your reputation. You will gain the favor of the spirits, which will please your villagers.
Reward_WoodcutterProficiency_Generic_Des: Woodcutters have a {0} chance of producing twice the normal yield.
Reward_WoodcuttingForFuel_Desc: Woodcutting speed is increased by {0}, but fuel consumption in Hearths is increased by {1}.
Reward_WoodForInsects_Desc: Gain {0} to wood production. After each storm, all stored wood is removed, and you get {1} in return.

Ruin_Haunted_Generic_Description: This building is haunted by evil spirits. They are protecting it because it's one of a kind. It can be rebuilt or destroyed.

Seal_Exploration_Blood_Desc: The blood of the first discovered forest spirit. They have not always avoided us, but over the years, our greed has lost us their trust. That's why they're running away in terror at the mere sight of a mortal. Their blood allows us to see into the future.
Seal_Exploration_Essence_Desc: A sinister, forbidden essence trapped in stone. There is an aura of uneasiness surrounding it, paired with the feeling of being watched by some hidden entity. It was probably created by the Fishmen during the reign of their masters, the Sealed Ones.
Seal_Exploration_Feathers_Desc: The feathers of a Stormbird are extremely difficult to obtain. They must be plucked directly from its wings, as Stormbirds do not shed their feathers. Many who have tried have fallen in the pursuit of this challenge, but those who succeed are remembered forever.
Seal_Exploration_Heart_Desc: A mystical mineral with the power to create and take life. Hidden deep in the darkest parts of the forest, it was once retrieved by the Explorers Guild at the Queen's request.
Seal_Industry_Blood_Desc: Necessity is the mother of invention. This is blood that never clots. It flows perfectly through the chambers and atria of any heart, breathing life into them. Designed through the close collaboration of Beaver engineers and Harpy alchemists, its exact formula remains a secret.
Seal_Industry_Essence_Desc: "And in the end, the Blight came. Death, at last, shall spread its wings over all. The few who survive the Blightstorm will see what has been hidden until now." - so says the prophecy of the living, corrupted stone.
Seal_Industry_Feathers_Desc: Forged in the fires of the Ancient Hearth itself, made of metals extracted from the deepest mines. Designing them was one of the greatest challenges for rainpunk engineers. With their help, the Guardian will rise above the Storm clouds - just as the legends foretold.
Seal_Industry_Heart_Desc: A marvelous work of art created by Beaver engineers. Made of the most valuable materials to ensure durability and reliability. It imitates a living heart by pumping infused rainwater into its chambers.
Seal_Resolve_Blood_Desc: Everyone knows the price. To free us and cleanse the land of eternal evil, sacrifice is needed. However, the blood of the wretched soul is of no use - the sacrifice must come from someone who is truly happy.
Seal_Resolve_Essence_Desc: Sit and listen. Gaze into the Holy Flame. It shows us the way. We owe our lives to it. It speaks to us, but only the most experienced Firekeepers will hear its true voice. But when you ask them, all you will ever see in their eyes is a sparkling flame... That's what sacrifice is.
Seal_Resolve_Feathers_Desc: Majestic feathers that adorned the cape of the Queen herself. It is said that each feather has a different, unique power. They shimmer in all colors, depending on her mood. The Queen is willing to give you some of them, if you prove your worth.
Seal_Resolve_Heart_Desc: Something that kindles the fire in the Ancient Hearth has been hidden within it for centuries. A heart of the flame that lights our way through the greatest darkness. The core of the entire ancient structure. It is this artifact that will ignite the inside of the Guardian, giving it the strength for the final encounter.
Seal_Trading_Blood_Desc: A thick, golden resin extracted from Amber Trees growing deep in the Scarlet Orchard. The Merchant Guild regularly delivers it personally to the Queen. No one really knows what she uses it for.
Seal_Trading_Essence_Desc: The essence of what drives us also breathes life into the Ancient Guardian... Enchanted into a crystal ball and hidden in the caravan wagons of Sothur the Ancient, he refuses to say how he got it, and will only give it to someone who proves their worth.
Seal_Trading_Feathers_Desc: Crystal feathers decorate the chambers of the royal palace. The Merchant Guild is very proud of this costly gift, as it was them who presented it to the Queen, hoping to win her favor in times of need.
Seal_Trading_Heart_Desc: The legendary Amber Heart, vibrant with energy, has been hidden and guarded within the Royal Treasury for years. Its pulse echoes through the streets, giving a gentle rhythm to life in the Citadel.
SeasonalEffect_BlightForSparkdew_Desc: Machinery has to be cleaned with specially prepared Drizzle Water. Otherwise, Blightrot will spread. Once this effect activates, you have to pay {1} {0} (multiplied by the number of years). If you don't, 3 Blightrot Cysts will spawn in your settlement.
SeasonalEffect_BlightForSparkdew_Penalty: If you don't deliver the required goods, {0} Blightrot Cysts will spawn in your settlement.
SeasonalEffect_BlightMutation_Desc: The Blightrot has begun to mutate, creating a more invasive strain. Production buildings now also generate Blightrot during the storm.
SeasonalEffect_ClearanceForDrizzle_Desc: Some raindrops seem to have a golden hue. Gain {0} every time you gather {1}.
SeasonalEffect_CorruptionFavoringBlock_D: The spreading corruption strikes fear into the hearts of your villagers. No amount of assurance or flattery can change that. Favoring is unavailable while the Hearth is being corrupted.
SeasonalEffect_CreepingShadows_Child_Des: Global Resolve is decreased by {0} for {1} seconds due to a recently discovered glade (source: {2}).
SeasonalEffect_CreepingShadows_Desc: Discovering a glade during the storm will decrease Global Resolve by {0} for 3 minutes.
SeasonalEffect_CursedLand_Desc: It's no use making sacrifices during the storm here.
SeasonalEffect_CystImpatience_Desc: Blightrot contaminates everything you send to the Citadel. During the storm, the Queen's Impatience grows {0} faster for every Blightrot Cyst in your settlement.
SeasonalEffect_DeathBlightrot_Desc: Villagers report feeling sick, especially during the storm. When a villager leaves or dies, {0} Blightrot Cysts will appear in the settlement.
SeasonalEffect_DrizzleWaterPerMinute_Des: The rain seems to fall... slower. Gain {1} {0} per minute during the drizzle.
SeasonalEffect_FastFood_Desc: The salty air makes it easier to preserve food. Food production speed is increased by {0} during drizzle season.
SeasonalEffect_FertileNodes_Desc: The soil becomes saturated with the rain's essence during drizzle season. Gathering nodes depleted during the drizzle spawn fertile soil.
SeasonalEffect_FuelRateHostility_Desc: The humidity in this region is unbearable. Fuel consumption in Hearths is increased by {0} for each Hostility level (counting from level 0).
SeasonalEffect_GiftForReputation_Desc: Gain one free Cornerstone reroll each time you acquire a Reputation Point during drizzle season.
SeasonalEffect_GladesResolveInDrizzle_De: New year, new challenges. You gain a {0} bonus to planting speed during Drizzle season for every small glade you discover (as well as your starting glade).
SeasonalEffect_GoodsForSolvedRelics_Desc: It seems some inhabitants of the forest are grateful for your efforts. During drizzle season, every Dangerous or Forbidden Glade Event you complete will give you 40 random raw food.
SeasonalEffect_GrainInHarvester_Desc: The grain stalks have grown soft because of the air’s humidity. During drizzle season, workers in the Harvesters' Camp can gather <sprite name="[food raw] grain"> grain ({0}) from grain nodes.
SeasonalEffect_GreaterThreat_Desc: During the storm, receive {0} to Global Resolve for every Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) and Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">) discovered since the beginning of the settlement.
SeasonalEffect_GrimFate_Desc: The forest will claim a villager's life during each storm (multiplied by the number of years that have passed).
SeasonalEffect_HotSprings_Desc: Rainwater Geysers produce pleasant heat in their vicinity. Geyser Pump Operators get +10 to Resolve.
SeasonalEffect_ImpatienceForAmber_Desc: Due to this region's location, the Crown requires you to pay {1} {0} with each storm (multiplied by the number of years played). If you don't, you will get 1 Impatience point.
SeasonalEffect_ImpatienceForAmber_Penalt: If you don't pay the tax, you will gain {0} Impatience Point.
SeasonalEffect_Insects30_Desc: The clearings are abuzz with the sound of crickets. Gain {0} each time you discover a glade.
SeasonalEffect_LivingFarmfield_Desc: The rain carries a strange, rotten pollen with it. A Blood Flower will spawn somewhere in the settlement every {0} seconds.
SeasonalEffect_MarrowMine_Desc: Small pockets of bone marrow form in the ground and on trees. Gain {0} every time you produce {1} during drizzle season.
SeasonalEffect_MineInStorm_Desc: Strange voices call out from the depths. Villagers working in Mines get -10 to Resolve during the storm.
SeasonalEffect_MoreEventGoods_Desc: The drizzle in this region is very mild, making it the perfect season for looting. Increases the chance of doubling loot from events solved during the drizzle by {0} (this doesn't apply to perks and blueprints).
SeasonalEffect_MoreWaterConsumption_Desc: Infused rainwater slowly evaporates. You lose {0} unit of a random type of water for every {1} units of water used in Rain Engines.
SeasonalEffect_NaturalFiltration_Desc: Using Rain Engines causes a lot less Blightrot contamination due to the natural filtration processes of the surrounding vegetation. Blightrot Cysts grow {0} slower when using Rain Engines.
SeasonalEffect_NodesBonuses_Desc: Gatherers bring back twice the amount of secondary resources when collecting from gathering nodes.
SeasonalEffect_ProdSpeedForSparkdew_Desc: Machinery tends to overheat in this climate. {1} {0} is taken from you with every storm (multiplied by the number of years). If you can't pay, global production speed will be reduced by 33%.
SeasonalEffect_ProductiveFarmsInDrizzle_: Plants seem to grow exceptionally quickly after the storm. All buildings that use fertile soil produce {0} more goods during the drizzle, and all crops planted during the drizzle will yield {0} more when collected during clearance season.
SeasonalEffect_ProductiveMine_Desc: The ground is soft, and soaked with the rain's essence. Mines produce {1} more goods during drizzle season.
SeasonalEffect_ResistantCysts_Desc: Blightrot Cysts consume the storm's energy and become more resilient. Burning cysts takes {0} seconds longer.
SeasonalEffect_ResolveFastDrop_Desc: The dark skies above the settlement awaken a primal fear in all villagers. During the storm, all species' Resolve drops {0} faster.
SeasonalEffect_ResolveForWater_Desc: A pleasant, earthy scent is in the air. Gain +{0} to Global Resolve every time you use {1} units of water in Rain Engines.
SeasonalEffect_RottingWood_Desc: The rain is causing the trees to rot and fall apart. Woodcutters fell trees {0} faster, but have a {1} chance of destroying their yield.
SeasonalEffect_SpringEvents_Desc: After each storm comes a time of peace and regrowth. Gain {0} Reputation Points for every Dangerous or Forbidden Glade Event you complete during this drizzle season.
SeasonalEffect_SpringRoutes_Desc: After each storm, caravans find countless goods scattered along their routes. Every trade route you complete during drizzle season will give you 5 random packs of goods.
SeasonalEffect_StormClothes_Desc: Even the hardiest villagers need some sort of cover in this weather. Once this effect activates, every villager in your settlement will ask you for {1} {0}. If you can't provide the goods, Global Resolve will be lowered by -6 for 2 minutes.
SeasonalEffect_StormClothes_Penalty_Desc: Global Resolve is decreased by {0} for {1} seconds due to a missed payment (source: {2}).
SeasonalEffect_StormSacrifice_Desc: Strong gusts of wind strike the Holy Flame. Resources you sacrifice in the Ancient Hearth burn {0} quicker.
SeasonalEffect_TastyRain_Desc: The rain is sticky and tastes like wine. During drizzle season, <sprite name="[needs] wine"> wine ({0}) can be produced at the Rain Collector.
SeasonalEffect_TradeRouteStorm_Desc: As a result of heavy rainfall, during the storm, the travel time of trade routes is increased by {0}.
SeasonalEffect_UnearthlyElement_Desc: The firekeeper's power weakens in the face of an otherworldly force. The maximum number of sacrifice stacks in the Ancient Hearth is lowered by {0}.
SeasonalEffect_WeakHearth_Desc: The cover of the Ancient Hearth has been damaged due to an exceptionally strong storm. The Hearth's resistance has decreased by {0}.
SeasonalEffect_YearlyCysts_Desc: Blightrot seems to grow uncontrollably quickly in this region. Every storm season, {0} Blightrot Cysts appear in the settlement (multiplied by the number of years that have passed).
Spring_SmallSpring_Desc: Underground deposits of infused rainwater, heated by a nearby volcano. Can be extracted with a Geyser Pump, and used to power Rain Engines in production buildings.
StorageOperation_BlackMarketOffer_Desc: These goods were acquired through the Black Market.

StorageOperation_BlackMarketReroll_Desc: This was a payment for refreshing Black Market listings.

StorageOperation_BlueprintsReroll_Desc: These goods were used to pay for a blueprint reroll.
StorageOperation_BuildingMove_Desc: These goods were used as payment for moving a building.
StorageOperation_BuildingMoveRefund_Desc: These goods were returned to the warehouse after a building movement was canceled.
StorageOperation_BuildingRemoval_Desc: These goods were returned after a building or construction site was destroyed.
StorageOperation_BuildingUpgrade_Desc: These goods were used to upgrade a building.
StorageOperation_Construction_Desc: These goods were used for construction.
StorageOperation_CornerstonesDecline_Des: These goods were received as compensation for declining a Cornerstone.
StorageOperation_CornerstonesExtensionCo: These goods were used to pay for an additional cornerstone option.
StorageOperation_HearthFire_Desc: These goods were burned in a Hearth.
StorageOperation_HearthSacrifice_Desc: These goods were sacrificed in the Ancient Hearth.
StorageOperation_IngredientsReturn_Desc: These goods were returned to the warehouse when a villager carrying them was forced to abandon their task.
StorageOperation_InitialCaravan_Desc: These resources were brought here with the first caravan.
StorageOperation_ManualIngredientsReturn: These goods were returned to the warehouse from a building's ingredient storage (either manually, or after the building was destroyed).
StorageOperation_Newcomers_Desc: These goods were brought by newcomers.
StorageOperation_OrdersLogic_Desc: These goods were used to fulfill an order.
StorageOperation_OrdersRewards_Desc: These goods were given to you by the Crown for fulfilling an order.
StorageOperation_RainpunkUnlock_Desc: These goods were used to install Rain Engines in a production building.
StorageOperation_Trade_Desc: These goods were part of a transaction with a trader.
StorageOperation_TraderAssault_Desc: These goods were taken from a trader.
StorageOperation_TradeRoutes_Desc: These goods were part of a trade route transaction.
StorageOperation_TradeRoutesExtend_Desc: These goods were used to pay for the expansion of available trade routes.
StorageOperation_VillagersConsumption_De: These goods were consumed by your villagers during a break, or were used in a service building.

Suffix_RewardsPack_Uncommon: Contains a small number of goods and an uncommon perk.

TimedGoal_Phase3_WinGameOnMarshlands_Obj: Win {0} games on the Marshlands in one cycle.
TimedGoal_Phase3_WinGamesOnMoorlands_Obj: Win {0} games in the Scarlet Orchard in one cycle.

Trader_AncientTrader_Description: He might have <color=#e0e09f>service goods, crafting materials, blueprints for alchemical buildings, and perks</color> for sale. He is willing to buy packs of goods, fuel, cooked food, and service goods.
Trader_AncientTrader_Dialogue: "What a curious place... I still remember when this land was entirely under water."
Trader_BrassOrderTrader_Desc: He might have <color=#e0e09f>metal, fuel, tools, building materials, and a number of blueprints and perks</color> for sale. He is willing to buy packs of goods, resources, advanced building materials, metal, and some crafting materials.
Trader_BrassOrderTrader_Dialogue: "Take a look at my wares, viceroy. You won't find better quality materials anywhere in the kingdom."
Trader_FirstDawnCompanyTrader_Descriptio: He might have <color=#e0e09f>cooked and raw food, pottery, and tools, along with perks and blueprints tied to agriculture</color> for sale. He is willing to buy packs of goods, raw food, building materials and some crafting materials.
Trader_FirstDawnCompanyTrader_Dialogue: "I’ve got everything you need. And if I don't have it - you don't need it."
Trader_GeneralTrader_Desc: She might have <color=#e0e09f>raw food, basic resources, building materials, some crafting materials, and a small number of basic blueprints and perks</color> for sale. She is willing to buy packs of goods, raw food, basic resources, and some building materials.
Trader_GeneralTrader_Dialogue: "Can I interest you in something specific? Maybe some delicious grasscap mushrooms or Drizzlewing eggs?"
Trader_HermitTrader_Dialogue: "Do not be afraid, stranger. This forest is only hostile to those looking to exploit it."
Trader_RoyalTrader_AssaultTooltip_Desc: Villagers are afraid to even look at the Royal Guards. No one will obey your orders to attack.
Trader_RoyalTrader_Desc: He might have <color=#e0e09f>cooked food, building materials, tools, parts, advanced blueprints, and perks</color> for sale. He is willing to buy packs of goods, fuel, building materials, service goods, tools, and metal.
Trader_RoyalTrader_Dialogue: "May the Storm be gentle on you, viceroy."
Trader_SeerTrader_Dialogue: "The Blight might have taken my sight, but my journey is far from over. Take a look at what I’ve collected over the years."
Trader_ShamanTrader_Dialogue: The Holy Flame bless you, Viceroy. May I offer you some of my wares?
Trader_StolenKeysTrader_Desc: She might have <color=#e0e09f>tools, service goods, building materials, and perks</color> for sale. She is willing to buy packs of goods, cooked food, metal, building materials, fuel, and tools.
Trader_StolenKeysTrader_Dialogue: "I have treasures of the past the Crown won't miss back in the Smoldering City... "
Trader_SyndicateTrader_AssaultTooltip_De: Villagers know better than to cross the Black Amber Syndicate. No one dares to follow your orders to attack.
Trader_SyndicateTrader_Desc: He might have <color=#e0e09f>clothing, cooked food, service goods, fuel, containers, metal, wildfire essence, blueprints, and perks</color> for sale. He is willing to buy packs of goods, raw food, basic resources, metal, and some building materials.
Trader_SyndicateTrader_Dialogue: "Many greetings, Viceroy. Always a pleasure doing business with a friend of the Syndicate."
Trader_Trickster_Desc: Dullahan might have <color=#e0e09f>metal, fabrics, crafting materials, and packs of goods</color> for sale. He also sells <color=#e0e09f>mystery boxes</color>. He is willing to buy packs of goods, service goods, crafting materials, cooked food, and some raw resources.
Trader_Trickster_Dialogue: "Dare to see what's inside the box?"
Trader_WanderingMerchant_Dialogue: "How come you viceroys always want to haggle? My prices are non-negotiable."
Trader_WanderingTrader_Desc: She might have <color=#e0e09f>clothing, cooked food, raw materials, fuel, ancient tablets, parts, wildfire essence, blueprints, and perks</color> for sale. She is willing to buy packs of goods, raw food, basic resources, metal, and some building materials.
Tutorial_ End3: Establish a trade hub in this region and keep the forest at bay.
Tutorial_ SeasonalEffects1: Each region has a unique set of seasonal effects called Forest Mysteries.
Tutorial_ SeasonalEffects2: The positive ones are active during Drizzle and the negative ones during the Storm.
Tutorial_ SeasonalEffects3: The higher the Hostility level, the more negative effects the Storm will bring.
Tutorial_BlightrotGrowth: The consumption of Rainwater leads to the growth of a parasite known as Blightrot.
Tutorial_BlightrotSeasons: During Drizzle and Clearance, Cysts retreat into their protective shells and pose no threat.
Tutorial_BlightrotStorm: However, during the Storm, Blightrot will attempt to corrupt your Hearth and devour your villagers.
Tutorial_CapitalGoal: Your goal as a Viceroy is to help rebuild it, and secure the future of the Queen's subjects.
Tutorial_CapitalUpgrade: Enter the Smoldering City and use the resources you've gathered so far to buy the Obsidian Archive Level 1 upgrade.
Tutorial_CycleIntro: This world is governed by the eternal Blightstorm Cycle...
Tutorial_CyclePreFinish: It is almost upon us, so no caravans are allowed to embark. Press the button in the lower right corner of the screen to finish the cycle.
Tutorial_EmbarkCaravans: To embark, you must first choose a caravan that will become the foundation of your town's population.
Tutorial_EmbarkDifficulty: Next, choose a difficulty. The higher the risk, the greater the reward. But beware - an inexperienced viceroy won't last long on the higher difficulties.
Tutorial_EmbarkIntro: You’re almost ready to venture out on your own. Choose any map tile inside your embarkation range to begin.
Tutorial_EmbarkPoints: Lastly, use all of your Embarkation Points to take extra goods with you.
Tutorial_End1: Build a Woodcutters' Camp and explore the forest. You have to keep the fire going at all times.
Tutorial_End2: Build a Farm, harvest grain, and serve some ale in a Tavern.
Tutorial_Farming1: Farmers can plant only on farm fields, and those can only be built on fertile soil...
Tutorial_Farming2: Crops are planted in the first season (drizzle) and harvested during the second (clearance).
Tutorial_GameCamera: Use {0}, {1}, {2}, {3} or the mouse to move the camera.
Tutorial_Hostility1: As your town grows, the forest around you becomes more and more hostile.
Tutorial_Hostility2: Each Hostility level lowers the Resolve of your villagers and makes the Storm harsher.
Tutorial_Hostility3: One of your main responsibilities is to manage hostility as you develop your settlement.
Tutorial_Impatience: Neglecting your village will increase the Queen's <color=#C8291D>Impatience</color> and bring her wrath upon you…
Tutorial_InstallingEngines: Let's try to install Rainpunk Engines in this Toolshop. Press the button to connect pipes.
Tutorial_Needs: Satisfying your villagers' needs with complex food, homes, and services will increase their Resolve.
Tutorial_Needs2: Each species has a different mix of needs. It's hard to please everyone all of the time.
Tutorial_Rainpunk: Rainpunk is a technology that harnesses the power of charged rainwater to enhance industrial buildings.
Tutorial_RainpunkPrice: However, using Rainpunk comes at a price.
Tutorial_Reputation: Fulfilling your duties will increase the town's <color=#1DA4C8>Reputation</color>, unlock new buildings and eventually bring you to victory.
Tutorial_Reputation_Pick: Now, choose a new blueprint. Select the crown icon below.
Tutorial_ResolveHigh: Keeping Resolve exceptionally high will grant passive Reputation over time.
Tutorial_ResolveLow: Villagers with low Resolve will start leaving, increasing the Queen’s Impatience.
Tutorial_Seals: Your goal as a viceroy is to reach the Ancient Seals with your caravan and reforge them, pushing back the Blightstorm.
Tutorial_Tut4Goal: Build a metallurgical complex in this region and repel the Blightrot.
Tutorial_UsingEngines: Each piped building is equipped with two engines: a primary one to improve production and a secondary one to improve working conditions.
Tutorial_WorldEnd: You are finally ready to embark on your own. Remember, there is always a way out. Experiment and adapt.
Tutorial_WorldEnd_2: May the storm be gentle on you, viceroy.
Tutorial_WorldIntro: The world is a vast, ever-changing place, and at its heart lies the Smoldering City...
UniqueGoal_Phase1_WinGameWithGrain_Objec: Win a game with {2} grain in the Warehouse.
UniqueGoal_Phase1_WinGameWithPaths_Objec: Win a game with {2} paths built.
UniqueGoal_Phase2_WinGameWithoutOrders_O: Win a game without completing any orders.
UniqueGoal_Phase2_WinGameWithResolve_Obj: Win a game having gained at least {1} Reputation Points through Resolve.

This update also brings with it a lot of balance changes to Glade Events, three new decorations, UI improvements to Orders, and numerous bug fixes.
